/Lotus/Powersuits/Archwing/SupportJetPac.name: <ARCHWING> Amesha
/Lotus/Powersuits/Archwing/SupportJetPac.zhDescription: （英文：AMESHA）化身成一名飞翼守护者。

abilities.description: Tiny drones orbit the Warframe or an ally, and intercept enemy fire.
abilities.zhDescription: 释放小型无人机围绕着战甲或队友并拦截敌人的火力。

abilities.description: Creates beacons that draw enemy fire, converting the damage into healing pulses.
abilities.zhDescription: 制造信标来吸引敌人的火力，将伤害转换为治疗的脉冲。

abilities.description: Renders the Warframe and nearby allies immune to Status Effects, while slowing nearby enemies.
abilities.zhDescription: 使得 战甲和附近的队友免疫异常状态，同时减缓附近敌人的速度。

abilities.description: All damage taken is transformed into Energy, while abilities gain enhanced Range, Duration and Power. Affects the Warframe and nearby allies.
abilities.zhDescription: 将所有受到的伤害会转换成能量，同时技能会得到范围，持续时间和强度上的提升。这个效果会影响战甲和附近的队友。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Archwing/StealthJetPac.name: <ARCHWING> Itzal
/Lotus/Powersuits/Archwing/StealthJetPac.description: Designed for quick clandestine attacks, the Itzal Archwing excels at striking from the darkness of space.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Archwing/StealthJetPac.zhDescription: （英文：ITZAL）专为隐匿行动而打造，这架曲翼擅长在太空的黑暗中进行突袭作战。

abilities.description: Launch a tethered hook that either pulls enemies close, or pulls the Warframe toward any stationary objects it hooks onto.
abilities.zhDescription: 发射一道钩索把敌人拉近，或是把战甲拉向被其钩住的任何一个静止物体。

abilities.description: Activates a cloaking field that hides the Warframe and any nearby allies who remain stationary.
abilities.zhDescription: 展开一道隐形力场，使静止于力场中的战甲与友军隐匿行踪。

abilities.description: Forms a miniature black hole that sucks in all nearby objects before rupturing in a massive shock wave.
abilities.zhDescription: 形成一个会吸进附近所有物体的微型黑洞，并在最后爆裂造成大规模的冲击震波。

abilities.description: Deploys drones that fight alongside the Warframe, each detonating in a destructive blast when killed.
abilities.zhDescription: 部署数台无人战机于战甲身旁进行战斗，当无人战机被破坏时会造成毁灭性的爆炸。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Archwing/StandardJetPa.name: <ARCHWING> Odonata
/Lotus/Powersuits/Archwing/StandardJetPa.description: The systems built into this Archwing balance offensive capabilities with defensive countermeasures.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Archwing/StandardJetPa.zhDescription: （英文：ODONATA）这组曲翼的系统拥有均衡的攻防能力。

abilities.description: Forms a protective energy shell around the Warframe
abilities.zhDescription: 形成一个围绕并保护着战甲的能量护罩。

abilities.description: Drops flare beacons confusing incoming guided missiles.
abilities.zhDescription: 放出可以混淆敌方导弹接近的热诱弹。

abilities.description: Fires a large volley of homing missiles.
abilities.zhDescription: 连续发射大量导弹。

abilities.description: The Warframe emits a massive pulse of energy, stunning nearby enemies and sending them flying.
abilities.zhDescription: 战甲放出巨大的能量脉冲，晕眩并击飞附近的敌人。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Archwing/PrimeJetPack/.name: <ARCHWING> Odonata Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Archwing/PrimeJetPack/.description: This enhanced version of the first Archwing prototype takes the design to its theoretical limits.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Archwing/PrimeJetPack/.zhDescription: （英文：ODONATA PRIME）第一架曲翼原型的强化机型，已将其设计为到理论上的极限状态。

abilities.zhDescription: 形成一个围绕并保护着战甲的能量护罩。

abilities.description: Drops flare beacons confusing incoming guided missiles.
abilities.zhDescription: 放出可以混淆敌方导弹接近的热诱弹。

abilities.description: Fires a large volley of homing missiles.
abilities.zhDescription: 连续发射大量导弹。

abilities.description: The Warframe emits a massive pulse of energy, stunning nearby enemies and sending them flying.
abilities.zhDescription: 战甲放出巨大的能量脉冲，晕眩并击飞附近的敌人。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Archwing/DemolitionJet.name: <ARCHWING> Elytron
/Lotus/Powersuits/Archwing/DemolitionJet.description: This heavy duty Archwing was designed for one purpose, destruction.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Archwing/DemolitionJet.zhDescription: （英文：ELYTRON）这种重型曲翼只为了一个目的而被设计出来：破坏。

abilities.description: Fires a high-yield, remotely detonated explosive projectile capable of latching onto targets.
abilities.zhDescription: 发射出一枚可附着在目标上并遥控引爆的高效爆裂物。

abilities.description: Vents out the Archwing's propulsion core, confusing enemy projectiles and causing them to detonate.
abilities.zhDescription: 将曲翼推进器核心中的气体排出，混淆并使敌方导弹引爆。

abilities.description: Creates a localized storm of punishing explosions.
abilities.zhDescription: 在指定区域中制造出一阵局部轰炸风暴。

abilities.description: Launches a plodding missile capable of unleashing a massive explosion.
abilities.zhDescription: 发射出一枚能造成大规模爆炸的慢速导弹。

/Lotus/Powersuits/YinYang/YinYang.name: Equinox
/Lotus/Powersuits/YinYang/YinYang.description: Equinox rises from the edge of day and night. Her Day form offers offensive support while her Night form offers defensive support. She thrives between realms.
/Lotus/Powersuits/YinYang/YinYang.zhDescription: Equinox 从白昼与黑夜的边缘崛起。她的白昼形态提供攻击支援，她的黑夜形态提供防御支援。她在白昼与黑夜之间来回游走。

abilities.description: Switch forms, temporarily gaining bonus Shields and Armor in Night-Form, or bonus Damage and Speed in Day-Form.
abilities.zhDescription: 昼夜交替：〈黑夜形态〉暂时获得额外护盾和护甲；〈白昼形态〉暂时获得额外伤害和速度。

abilities.description: In Night-Form, targets are put to sleep. In Day-Form, targets become more vulnerable to damage.
abilities.zhDescription: 〈黑夜形态〉使目标敌人陷入沉睡；〈白昼形态〉对目标敌人造成更多伤害。

abilities.description: In Night-Form, reduces damage inflicted by nearby enemies. In Day-Form, increases Ability Strength of nearby allies.
abilities.zhDescription: 〈黑夜形态〉时降低周围敌人造成的伤害。〈白昼形态〉时则增加附近友军的技能强度。

abilities.description: In Night-Form, allies' Shields are replenished with each nearby enemy killed. In Day-Form, enemies are inflicted with <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effect. Deactivate while in Night-Form to restore Health and Shields for Equinox and allies. Deactivate while in Day-Form to cast a wave of slashing force.
abilities.zhDescription: 〈黑夜型态〉在附近被击杀的每一名敌人都能使友军恢复护盾。〈白昼型态〉使附近敌人陷入 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态，在〈黑夜型态〉时停用技能来为 Equinox 及友军恢复生命及护盾。在〈白昼型态〉时停用技能来释放出一波切割之力。

/Lotus/Powersuits/YinYang/EquinoxPrime.name: Equinox Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/YinYang/EquinoxPrime.description: Night and Day in final balance; the graceful perfection of the one that walks the borders.
/Lotus/Powersuits/YinYang/EquinoxPrime.zhDescription: 昼夜的最终平衡形态；行走于界线上的优美之型。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Yareli/YareliPrime.name: Yareli Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Yareli/YareliPrime.description: The Waverider arises, reborn from the ocean foam. In her original Orokin-era splendor she embodies the undying vigor of youth.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Yareli/YareliPrime.zhDescription: 驭浪者从海浪中重生。她以奥罗金时代的风采，体现出青春不朽的活力。

abilities.description:
Form five water globules that seek out enemies and expand on contact, simultaneously damaging and immobilizing their victims.
Enemies hit by the globules take increased damage from all sources.
abilities.zhDescription:
生成五个主动寻找敌人并会在触碰时膨胀的水球，同时对受害者造成伤害并使他们无法移动。
被水球击中的敌人受到所有来源的伤害都会增加。

abilities.description: Summon Merulina, a rideable creature of the waves, and the inspiration for K-Driving. Merulina protects Yareli by absorbing a large portion of incoming damage.
abilities.zhDescription: 召唤浪漪珊瑚，这是一种浪涌中的可骑乘生物，也是 K 式悬浮板的灵感来源。浪漪珊瑚通过吸收大部分来袭的伤害从而保护 Yareli。

abilities.description: Tear through foes with a trio of orbiting aquatic blades.
abilities.zhDescription: 通过一把三刃环绕的水形之刃来撕裂敌人。

abilities.description: Drag enemies into a crushing maelstrom and then blow them away in a watery burst. Each enemy trapped in the vortex increases the burst's damage.
abilities.zhDescription: 把敌人拖入一个毁灭性的漩涡中，然后用一股爆裂水压将他们炸飞。每个被困在漩涡中的敌人都会增加爆裂造成的伤害。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Yareli/Yareli.name: Yareli
/Lotus/Powersuits/Yareli/Yareli.description: The waverider can unleash a flood of destruction on the battlefield. Yareli’s aqueous attacks deal high damage. Surf’s up. Enemies down.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Yareli/Yareli.zhDescription: 驭浪者可以在战场上释放出毁灭的洪流。Yareli 的水系攻击可对敌人造成高额伤害。驭浪而上，敌军溺亡。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Wraith/Wraith.name: Sevagoth
/Lotus/Powersuits/Wraith/Wraith.description: No longer adrift in the Void, Sevagoth has returned. He and his Shadow deal heavy damage and have high survivability. They are sustained by the reaping of wayward souls.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Wraith/Wraith.zhDescription: Sevagoth 不再漂泊虚空，已经回归。他和他的幽影能够造成巨大的伤害，并具有极强的生存能力。他们通过收割那些迷途的灵魂来维持自身的力量。

abilities.description: Sevagoth's Shadow flies outward ravaging enemies in his path. Survivors are damaged by Death's Harvest over time. The souls of the dead fill the Death Well.
abilities.zhDescription: Sevagoth 的幽影向外飞去来蹂躏路径上的敌人。幸存者会随时间流逝，受到来自「死亡收割」的伤害。亡魂将会注入「死亡之井」。

abilities.description: Plant a death seed in nearby targets to drain their lifeforce. Reap what has been sown to detonate afflicted enemies, dealing a percentage of their health as radial damage. The souls of the dead fill the Death Well.
abilities.zhDescription: 向附近的目标种下死亡之种来汲取他们的生命力。收割已播种的死亡之种来引爆受影响的敌人，并按照他们生命值的百分比来造成范围伤害。亡魂将会注入「死亡之井」。

abilities.description: Summon a radial pulse wave that ensnares and slows enemies, siphoning their lifeforce for the Death Well. Allies within the wave steal health with each attack.
abilities.zhDescription: 召唤一道放射脉冲波，来诱捕敌人落入技能范围并使其减速，同时吸取他们的生命力并注入「死亡之井」。处在脉冲波范围内的友军每次攻击都会吸取敌人的生命值。

abilities.description: When the Death Well fills, Sevagoth's Shadow form is ready to be released. Tear the enemy asunder with a collection of melee-focused abilities.
abilities.zhDescription: 当「死亡之井」被注满时，将能够释放 Sevagoth 的幽影形态；并可使用一系列近战技能撕裂敌人。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Wraith/SevagothPrime.name: Sevagoth Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Wraith/SevagothPrime.description: The gilded helmsman emerges from the tempest, his shadow a lure for doomed souls.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Wraith/SevagothPrime.zhDescription: 镀金舵手从暴风雨中现身，他的身影吸引着注定悲怆的灵魂。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Wisp/WispPrime.name: Wisp Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Wisp/WispPrime.description: Wisp Prime’s gilded splendor haunts the battlefield. Allies welcome her interdimensional beauty.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Wisp/WispPrime.zhDescription: Wisp Prime 的镀金光彩萦绕在战场上。盟友也十分期待她的多维美貌。

abilities.description: Choose and summon a Reservoir filled with Motes that attach to and aid Wisp and her allies. Haste Mote grants increased movement and attack speed. Vitality Mote increases maximum health and heals over time. Shock Mote stuns nearby enemies.
abilities.zhDescription: 选择并召唤一个充满尘埃的储能池来帮助 Wisp 和她的友军。急速尘埃可以增加移动和攻击速度。活力尘埃可以增加最大生命值和治疗时间。震荡尘埃可以震晕附近的敌人。

abilities.description: Cast forward a spectral image of Wisp to confuse and distract enemies. Reactivate to travel to its position. Hold to have the image travel faster and teleport to its position on release.
abilities.zhDescription: 投射一个 Wisp 的光谱图像来迷惑和分散敌人的注意力。重新启动图像来移动到它所在的位置。按住按键来使图像移动速度更快，并在释放按键时传送到它所在的位置。

abilities.description:
Open a dimensional breach to overwhelm nearby enemies and cause them to release aggressive Surge sparks when damaged.
Wisp may also target a Reservoir to teleport to it and double the range of the surge.
abilities.zhDescription:
打开一个维度缺口来压倒附近的敌人，并使他们在受到伤害时释放出侵略性的电涌火花。
Wisp 亦可瞄准一个储能池传送，并倍化涌流的范围。

abilities.description: Open a portal to the sun to irradiate enemies with a devastating beam of pure solar plasma. Hold fire to double Damage at the cost of increased energy consumption. For the duration of an attack enemies damaged by Sol Gate are increasingly more vulnerable to it.
abilities.zhDescription: 打开一扇通往太阳的传送门，放出毁灭性的纯阳等离子光束。按住射击键会使伤害加倍，但同时也会增加能量消耗。当太阳之门持续攻击敌人时，会对敌人造成更多伤害。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Wisp/Wisp.name: Wisp
/Lotus/Powersuits/Wisp/Wisp.description: Wisp floats between the material and the ethereal. She accesses multiple dimensions to support her allies. Her countenance is mysterious and enigmatic.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Wisp/Wisp.zhDescription: Wisp 游走于物质和虚无之间。她可以进入多个维度，为友军提供支援。她的面容神秘莫测，让人捉摸不透。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Werewolf/Werewolf.name: Voruna
/Lotus/Powersuits/Werewolf/Werewolf.description: Four beasts, one heart. Voruna's loyal wolf pack makes for a deadly combination of strength and stealth. Beware the monstrous howl that heralds fangs of vengeance.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Werewolf/Werewolf.zhDescription: 四头野兽，同心一颗。Voruna 的忠诚狼群是力量与隐秘的致命结合。当心那伴随着可怕嚎叫的复仇獠牙。

abilities.description:
(TAP) Dynar shrouds Voruna with invisibility and accelerates her speed. Invisibility ends when Voruna attacks. For a short time after invisibility ends, melee attacks have increased Critical Damage, Status Chance, Critical Chance and inflict <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effects. Melee kill an enemy during this time to extend the melee buff once per cast.

(HOLD) Dynar guards Voruna, increasing her Parkour Velocity.
abilities.zhDescription:

/Lotus/Powersuits/Werewolf/VorunaPrime.description: Splendor and ferocity reach their savage apex in Voruna Prime. Though exalted by Orokin gold, she is more feral than ever.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Werewolf/VorunaPrime.zhDescription: 辉煌与凶猛在 Voruna Prime 身上达到了顶峰。虽然她被奥罗金黄金所装饰，却比以往任何时候都更具野性。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Volt/VoltPrime.description: A glorious warrior from the past, Volt Prime features the same abilities as Volt but with unique mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Volt/VoltPrime.zhDescription: 一位来自过去的荣耀战士，Volt Prime 拥有与 Volt 一样的技能，但自带独特的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

abilities.description: Launch a voltaic projectile that stuns and damages its target. A chain of electricity extends from the target to shock nearby enemies.

abilities.zhDescription: 友军将在伤害被能力吸取标记的敌人同时获得能量。

abilities.zhDescription: 链接激活时，一切受到的伤害将转移给身边的一个敌人。

abilities.description: Restore the health and shields of allies within <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range while reducing the damage they take from enemies.

abilities.description:
Control the battlefield with masterful mines. Vauban's Tether-Flechette orb immobilizes and draws in enemies while launching deadly nails in all directions.

HOLD to launch a Vector-Overdrive pad that accelerates foes and allies alike in the pad's direction, increasing ally Movement Speed and Weapon Damage.
abilities.zhDescription:
用精妙的地雷掌控战场。Vauban 的桎梏飞掷丸能束缚并吸引敌人，同时向四面八方发射致命的飞镖。

按住即可发射矢量超载垫，为垫子方向上的敌我双方加速，并提升友军的移动速度和武器伤害。

abilities.description: Drop a targeting beacon that calls in a devastating laser artillery strike. Deals doubled damage to enemies with Overguard.

abilities.description: Hold while airborne to hover Zephyr with reduced movement. From the air, tap to dash forward, or aim down to dive bomb enemies below.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Tengu/Tengu.description: Command the power of the wind. Zephyr’s cyclonic abilities protect her, deal high damage, and provide crowd control. She swoops in from above and leaves a path of destruction.

abilities.description:

Backbeat Timing: Invulnerability lasts longer.
abilities.zhDescription:
弹奏吉他，使 Temple 获得短暂无敌并同时获得治疗。每当随着反拍的节奏使用技能时并成功命中敌人时，<AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围内的友军武器都会被点亮并获得额外的 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害加成。

反拍节奏：无敌状态持续时间更长。

abilities.description:
Once a charge has been built up on the Backbeat metronome, set Lizzie aflame and torch enemies with <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat. While aimed, Lizzie blasts enemies with thunderous elemental sound waves, use ability controls to change the Elemental Damage type.

Backbeat Timing: No Energy consumed.
abilities.zhDescription:
一旦反拍节拍器上积聚了能量，丽兹就会燃烧起来，用 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰焚烧敌人。瞄准时，丽兹以轰鸣的元素声波轰击敌人，可通过技能按键发射不同元素类型的声波。

反拍节奏：本技能不消耗能量。

/Lotus/Powersuits/SiriusOrion/SiriusSuit.name: Sirius & Orion
/Lotus/Powersuits/SiriusOrion/SiriusSuit.description: Wield the power of the stars in a constant battle for supremacy. The dueling sons, Sirius & Orion, occupy the space of a single Warframe, jockeying for position to rain cosmic destruction upon foes.
/Lotus/Powersuits/SiriusOrion/SiriusSuit.zhDescription: 在永无休止的霸权争夺战中，驾驭星辰之力。Sirius 与 Orion 这对决斗之子，在同一个战甲中，彼此角力，争相占据有利位置，向敌人倾泻宇宙级的毁灭之力。

abilities.description:
Hurl Sirius' Jade Light infused scythe, dealing <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage while collecting any pickups in its path.

(HOLD) Swap to Orion and use Gravitic Slash.
abilities.zhDescription:
投掷 Sirius 的翠玉之光镰刀，造成 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害，并拾取路径上的所有物品。

（按住）切换到 Orion 并使用重力斩。

abilities.description:
Sirius conjures Jade Light motes that slowly regenerate over time. Attacking enemies launches the motes, dealing <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage and Status Effect.

(HOLD) Swap to Orion and use Astral Shell.
abilities.zhDescription:
Sirius 召唤翠玉之光微粒，这些微粒会随时间缓慢再生。攻击敌人会发射这些微粒，造成 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害和异常状态。

（按住）切换到 Orion 并使用星壳。

abilities.description:
Sirius creates a well of light that heals and revives allies, while reducing incoming damage. The well slowly grows in size and power.

(HOLD) Swap to Orion and use Event Horizon.
abilities.zhDescription:
Sirius 会创造一个光之井，治疗并复活友军，同时减少受到的伤害。光之井的体积和威力会缓慢增长。

（按住）切换到 Orion 并使用事件视界。

abilities.description:
Sirius & Orion take to the skies in a cosmic duel. Each attack consumes a Constellation Star to inflict colossal collateral |DAMAGE_TYPE| damage. Match the star's color to the Warframes color to gain increased Critical Chance.

|LEFT_ATTACK| Sirius attacks
|RIGHT_ATTACK| Orion attacks

Generate Constellation Stars by using abilities. No more than two stars of the same color can be added in a row.
abilities.zhDescription:
Sirius & Orion 在宇宙中展开决斗。每次攻击都会消耗一颗众星，造成巨大的附加 |DAMAGE_TYPE|伤害。将星星的颜色与战甲颜色匹配，可提高暴击几率。

|LEFT_ATTACK| Sirius 攻击
|RIGHT_ATTACK| Orion 攻击

使用技能以生成众星。同一颜色的星星最多只能连续生成两颗。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Sentient/Sentient.name: Caliban
/Lotus/Powersuits/Sentient/Sentient.description: The heir of twin kingdoms ascends. Biological and Sentient life meet in Caliban. An adept monarch, he offers crowd control and survivability. His creator had more than one world in mind.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Sentient/Sentient.zhDescription: 双生王国的继承人登场。生物与 Sentient 形态在 Caliban 身上交汇。作为一名老练的君主，他可以对敌人实施群体控制并拥有极强的生存能力。他的创造者心中有不止一个世界。

abilities.description: Dash forward in a spinning vortex of death. Struck enemies are inflicted with <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau Status Effect, making them more vulnerable to all other status effects. For each enemy hit, recover a portion of the energy cost, as well as health and shields. Enemies lifted by Sentient Wrath take increased damage.
abilities.zhDescription: 在旋转的死亡漩涡中向前冲刺。被击中的敌人会受到 <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau 异常状态的影响，使其更易受到其他所有异常状态的伤害。每击中一个敌人，可恢复一部分能量消耗，以及生命值和护盾。被 Sentient 之怒举起的敌人受到额外伤害。

abilities.description: Smash the ground sending out a radial wave of destruction. Those not killed by the initial blast are helplessly raised into the air, where they take amplified damage for a short time.
abilities.zhDescription: 猛击地面发射毁灭般的脉冲波。没有被最初的爆炸杀死的敌人会被无助地抛向空中，在短时间内受到放大的伤害。

abilities.description: Cycle through Sentient unit types, then summon them to Caliban's side. Conculysts focus on raw melee damage. Ortholysts specialize in ranged attacks and inflict <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau Status Effect. Summulysts summon their own Choralysts and provide shield protection for the squad.
abilities.zhDescription: 在 Sentient 单位类型之间切换，然后将其召唤到 Caliban 的身旁。震荡使专注于原始近战伤害。直垂使擅长远程攻击并且能造成 <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau 异常状态。召唤使能召唤自己的唱鸣使，并为小队提供护盾保护。

abilities.description: Converge three streams of raw energy upon a single point, causing a massive explosion. The streams strip armor and shields, and each enemy struck detonates on stream convergence. Summoned Conculysts can wield their own mini Fusion Strikes.
abilities.zhDescription: 将三股原始能量流汇聚至一个点上，引发巨大爆炸。这些能量流能剥离敌人的护甲和护盾，每个被击中的敌人都会在能量流汇聚时被引爆。召唤的震荡使可施放自己的迷你版融合打击。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Sentient/CalibanPrime.name: Caliban Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Sentient/CalibanPrime.description: Forged in celebration of the all-too-brief peace between the Orokin and Sentients, Caliban Prime is a true collaborative masterpiece. The heir of twin kingdoms arises in royal gold.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Sentient/CalibanPrime.zhDescription: Caliban Prime 是为了庆祝奥罗金与 Sentient 之间短暂的和平而打造的，堪称真正的合璧杰作。双生王国的继承者，身披皇家之金崛起。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Saryn/SarynPrime.name: Saryn Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Saryn/SarynPrime.description: A golden blossom conceals deadly nectar. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Saryn/SarynPrime.zhDescription: 一朵隐藏着致命花蜜的金花。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

abilities.description: Inflict a target with a pox of <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive spores. Spread spores to nearby enemies by destroying them or killing their host. The longer the Spore spreads, its damage will increase.
abilities.zhDescription: 使目标受到<DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀孢子的感染。破坏孢子或杀死宿主可以将孢子扩散到附近的敌人。孢子扩散的时间越久，伤害就越高。

abilities.description: Shedding her skin like a snake, Saryn leaves a decoy behind to draw fire from enemies.
abilities.zhDescription: Saryn 脱落如蛇般的皮肤，在身后留下诱饵吸引敌人的火力。

abilities.description: While active, attacks deal additional <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage; this effect is doubled for Melee Strikes. Instantly burst spores when attacking afflicted enemies.
abilities.zhDescription: 激活时，攻击将造成额外的 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害；该效果对近战攻击有双倍加成。攻击被孢子感染的敌人将立刻引爆孢子。

abilities.description: Release a poisonous miasma that deals <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage to enemies in range. Foes afflicted by spores are more susceptible to the mist.
abilities.zhDescription: 释放剧毒的瘴气，对范围内的敌人造成 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害。受到孢子影响的敌人会遭到毒雾更深的感染。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Saryn/Saryn.name: Saryn
/Lotus/Powersuits/Saryn/Saryn.description: Toxicity is Saryn’s strength. Her serpentine powers deal heavy damage. For Saryn, venom is a virtue.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Saryn/Saryn.zhDescription: 剧毒是 Saryn 的强项。她蛇一般的能力会造成巨大伤害。对 Saryn 来说，毒液是一种美德。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Sandman/Sandman.name: Inaros
/Lotus/Powersuits/Sandman/Sandman.description: Inaros commands the fearsome desert. He survives like the ever-shifting sands that empower him. Legend recalls Inaros as the Fear-Eater.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Sandman/Sandman.zhDescription: Inaros 统领着骇人的沙漠。他的生存之道如同赋予他力量的千变万化的沙漠。传说中的 Inaros 是恐惧的吞噬者。

abilities.description: Blast enemies with a wave of cursed sand that blinds them and steals their health.
abilities.zhDescription: 使用一波带有诅咒的沙尘卷向敌人，致盲的同时窃取对方的生命。

abilities.description: Become a sandstorm. Inaros devours enemies pulled into his whirlwind, healing himself.
abilities.zhDescription: 化身为沙尘暴。Inaros 吞噬被卷入沙暴中的敌人，并治愈自己。

abilities.description: Activate to form Armor by draining Inaros' Health. Activate again to stop the formation early. The protective layer reduces incoming Damage and absorbs Status Effects.
abilities.zhDescription: 将 Inaros 的生命值来转化为护甲。再次使用可以提前终止护甲的转化。保护层减少受到的伤害并使 Inaros 免疫异常状态。

abilities.description: Summon a Scarab Swarm to attack enemies with guaranteed <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Status. Damage scales with Inaros' Health. Enemies killed while immersed in the swarm summon a Swarm Kavat that fights alongside Inaros and guides the scarabs to other enemies.
abilities.zhDescription: 召唤带有 <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀触发效果的圣甲虫群来攻击敌人。伤害与 Inaros 的生命值成正比。被虫群淹没的敌人死亡后会召唤一个沙土库娃，与 Inaros 并肩作战，并引导圣甲虫找到其他敌人。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Sandman/InarosPrime.name: Inaros Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Sandman/InarosPrime.description: Rise, eternal, to cast the fear of Inaros into them. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Sandman/InarosPrime.zhDescription: 唤醒这永恒的存在，以此来把 Inaros 带来的恐惧施加到他们身上。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Runner/Runner.name: Gauss
/Lotus/Powersuits/Runner/Runner.description: Take charge with the Saint of Altra. Gauss is fast, deals high damage, and has strong survivability. Movement charges his powerful battery, so never stop moving.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Runner/Runner.zhDescription: 与阿尔特拉的圣者一同主宰战场。Gauss 速度快，伤害高，生存能力强。移动可以为他的强大电池充电，因此绝不停下脚步。

abilities.description: Burst into a hyper-sprint bowling over enemies and charging the battery. Crashing into solid objects generates a powerful shockwave. Hold to rush continuously.
abilities.zhDescription: 猛冲产生一个超级冲刺来撞倒敌人并对电池蓄电，或是撞上坚固的物体来产生强大的震荡波。长按按键以持续冲刺。

abilities.description: Generate armor plating that converts a portion of absorbed Kinetic Damage (Physical, <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat, <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold, and <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>Blast) into Energy. Also protects Gauss from being staggered or knocked down. Damage Resistance is relative to the battery level.
abilities.zhDescription: 产生可以将一部份所吸收的动能伤害（物理、<DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰、<DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻，以及　<DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>爆炸）转成能量的动能镀层。同时也保护 Gauss 免于失去平衡或是被击倒。伤害抗性与电池电量是相对的。

abilities.description: Siphon kinetic energy from the area, charging the battery and inflicting <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status on nearby enemies. Hold reverses the process, draining the battery and inflicting <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Status on nearby enemies.
abilities.zhDescription: 从附近区域吸取动能，为电池蓄电并为附近的敌人带来<DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻状态。长按按键来逆转这一过程，通过消耗电池来使附近的敌人处于<DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害的状态中。

abilities.description: Push Gauss' battery beyond the redline, supercharging his Abilities and setting Fire Rate, Attack Speed, Reload Speed, and Casting Speed into overdrive. When past the redline, bolts of arcing electricity dance periodically from Gauss, exploding en masse when the ability is deactivated.
abilities.zhDescription: 将 Gauss 的电池过载至超出安全上限，大幅增强他的技能并将射速、攻击速度、装填速度，以及施放速度都设置为超载状态。当超出安全上限时，电弧束会周期性地在 Gauss 身上跃动，并在技能停用时爆炸。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Runner/GaussPrime.name: Gauss Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Runner/GaussPrime.description: Quicksilver takes form. Gauss Prime brooks no talk of defeat.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Runner/GaussPrime.zhDescription: 以水银打造的外型。Gauss Prime 不容失败。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Rhino/RhinoPrime.name: Rhino Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Rhino/RhinoPrime.description: Takes Rhino's ground-shaking abilities to the next level with altered mod polarities that offer greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Rhino/RhinoPrime.zhDescription: 通过将极性插槽改为更适合自定的配置，使 RHINO 地面震动能力发挥到更高水平。

abilities.description: Rhino charges towards a target, clobbering any in his path and goring his victim.
abilities.zhDescription: Rhino 向目标冲锋，击倒突进路径上的一切阻碍，并以犀角强烈顶击目标。

abilities.description: Rhino hardens his skin, insulating himself from all damage and gaining Overguard.
abilities.zhDescription: Rhino 硬化他的皮肤，隔绝一切伤害并获得超宏防护。

abilities.description: Grants all nearby Warframes increased damage for a short duration.
abilities.zhDescription: 短时间内让所有附近的战甲提升伤害输出。

abilities.description: Rhino stomps with force sufficient to disrupt time, tumbling enemies around him in stasis.
abilities.zhDescription: Rhino 的强力践踏可以扰乱时间秩序，将周围的敌人锁定在时间中。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Rhino/Rhino.name: Rhino
/Lotus/Powersuits/Rhino/Rhino.description: Rhino packs a punch. He boasts high survivability and crowd control. The wise would do well to stand clear when he charges.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Rhino/Rhino.zhDescription: Rhino 重拳以待。他拥有很高的生存能力和群体控制技能。当他冲锋时，明智的人都会选择不要站在他的对面。

abilities.description: Rhino charges towards a target, clobbering any in his path and goring his victim.
abilities.zhDescription: Rhino 向目标冲锋，击倒突进路径上的一切阻碍，并以犀角强烈顶击目标。

abilities.description: Rhino hardens his skin, insulating himself from all damage and gaining Overguard.
abilities.zhDescription: Rhino 硬化他的皮肤，隔绝一切伤害并获得超宏防护。

abilities.description: Grants all nearby Warframes increased damage for a short duration.
abilities.zhDescription: 短时间内让所有附近的战甲提升伤害输出。

abilities.description: Rhino stomps with force sufficient to disrupt time, tumbling enemies around him in stasis.
abilities.zhDescription: Rhino 的强力践踏可以扰乱时间秩序，将周围的敌人锁定在时间中。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Revenant/RevenantPrime.name: Revenant Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Revenant/RevenantPrime.description: The lost one rises. Reify the essence of the Eidolon as you wield Revenant Prime’s power.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Revenant/RevenantPrime.zhDescription: 迷失者之崛起。使用 Revenant Prime 的力量，来具象化夜灵之力。

abilities.description: Convert a target into a zealous thrall. Thralls turn on their allies and enthrall through damage. On death, they disintegrate into a damaging pillar of energy. The thrall horde remains under Revenants spell until this ability runs out.
abilities.zhDescription: 将目标转化为一个狂热的奴仆。奴仆会攻击他们的友军，并通过伤害奴役更多目标。当目标死亡后，将会分解为可以产生伤害的能量柱。成群的奴仆将持续受到 Revenant 控制，直到此技能结束。

abilities.description: Become enveloped in Sentient energy, redirecting damage and stunning all those who dare attack. Stunned enemies can be Enthralled at no energy cost.
abilities.zhDescription: 受到 Sentient 能量包围，偏转伤害并震晕胆敢攻击者。奴役被震晕的敌人不消耗能量。

abilities.description: Dash through enemies as a wall of sentient energy, leeching shields and health from any encountered, enhanced for thralls.
abilities.zhDescription: 化为一堵由 Sentient 能量组成的墙壁穿过敌人，吸取所接触敌人的护盾和生命，来自奴仆的效果受到增幅。

abilities.description: Erupt with a multitude of Eidolon energy beams and sweep a circle of death around Revenant. The beams will modify their Damage Type to target select defenses, while incoming damage is redirected back into the beams. Hold fire to boost Status Effects and Damage, at the cost of increased energy consumption. Thralls killed by this ability leave overshield pickups.
abilities.zhDescription: 喷发出数条夜灵能量光束，形成一个死亡之环扫荡 Revenant 的四周。光束会根据所选的防御调整伤害类型，而 Revenant 遭受的伤害将转化为光束伤害。按住射击键可以额外能量为代价强化异常状态和伤害。被此技能杀死的奴仆将掉落过载护盾可拾取物。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Revenant/Revenant.name: Revenant
/Lotus/Powersuits/Revenant/Revenant.description: Macabre spectral power has risen. Infused with the essence of the Eidolon, Revenant has strong survivability and deals high damage. Enemies become his thralls.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Revenant/Revenant.zhDescription: 恐怖的恶灵之力已经涌现。融合了夜灵本质的 Revenant，拥有强大的生存能力和高额伤害。敌人皆成为他的奴仆。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Ranger/Ranger.name: Ivara
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ranger/Ranger.description: The huntress draws her bow. Ivara is stealth itself. Her enemies live in fear of her sudden attacks.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ranger/Ranger.zhDescription: 女猎手拉动了她的弓箭。 Ivara 善于潜行。她的敌人时刻被她突袭的恐惧所笼罩。

abilities.description: Cycle through and shoot one of four tactical arrows. Cloak creates a stationary bubble that cloaks Ivara and allies. Dashwire creates a traversable zipline. Noise emits a high-pitched sound that attracts enemies to it. Sleep temporarily puts nearby enemies into a deep slumber.
abilities.zhDescription: 循环切换并射击出四种战术箭矢之一。隐蔽会创造一个使 Ivara 和队友隐形的固定球体。悬丝则可形成一道滑索。喧扰会发出高频声波并吸引敌人。沉睡之箭能使附近的敌人陷入沉睡。

abilities.description: Assume control of any projectile launched by Ivara and guide it to the target.
abilities.zhDescription: 操控 Ivara 所发射出的投射物并引导飞向目标处。

abilities.description: Become invisible and steal loot from unsuspecting enemies or take out prey with deadly headshots.
abilities.zhDescription: 进入隐身状态并从毫无警觉的敌人身上偷取道具，或以致命的爆头射击取走猎物的性命。

abilities.description: Summon a mighty bow and unleash a volley of devastating arrows.
abilities.zhDescription: 召唤出一把强力长弓并发动毁灭性的集中箭矢射击。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Ranger/IvaraPrime.name: Ivara Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ranger/IvaraPrime.description: As regal and lethal as a nighttime wood, this is the queen of the hunt in her ultimate form.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ranger/IvaraPrime.zhDescription: 像夜间的树林一样庄严与致命，这就是狩猎女王的终极形态。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Priest/Priest.name: Harrow
/Lotus/Powersuits/Priest/Priest.description: Achieve redemption through vengeance. The monastic Harrow increases damage to support allies. Defy enemies and ascend.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Priest/Priest.zhDescription: 通过复仇来实现救赎。僧侣般的 Harrow 会增幅友军的杀伤力，为其提供支援。克敌制胜，超越自我。

abilities.description: Cast a wave of energy that chains them where they stand. Each enemy held reinforces Harrow's shields.
abilities.zhDescription: 释放一道能量波动将敌人锁在原地。每一个被锁住的敌人都将强化 Harrow 的护盾。

abilities.description: Sacrifice Shields to boost Reload Speed, and Fire Rate while converting damage inflicted on enemies into health for Harrow and nearby allies.
abilities.zhDescription: 牺牲一定护盾来提升装填和射速，同时将施加于敌人的伤害转化为 Harrow 和附近友军的生命。

abilities.description: Channel Harrow's energy into the Thurible to generate a buff. Once finished, kill enemies to bestow nearby allies with bursts of energy. The more energy channeled the greater the reward for each kill. Weak Point kills produce extra energy.
abilities.zhDescription: 将 Harrow 的能量导引至「聚能焚炉」以产生增幅效果。一旦导引完成，击杀敌人就会给予附近友军能量喷发。导引使用的能量越多，每个击杀获得的返还奖励就越高。弱点击杀可产生额外能量。

abilities.description: Protect nearby allies with an energy force that absorbs all damage and converts it to a Critical Chance bonus for all those under the Covenant. Weak Point hits are amplified even further.
abilities.zhDescription: 以能量保护附近的友军，对处于「庇佑圣约」保护下的所有人，可吸收一切伤害并将之转化为暴击几率的加成。如果击中弱点，暴击几率将被进一步增幅。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Priest/HarrowPrime.name: Harrow Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Priest/HarrowPrime.description: The Inquisitor Eternal arises, hallowed by the Void, preaching a gospel of iron and flame.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Priest/HarrowPrime.zhDescription: 永恒的审判官已经崛起，受虚空洗礼，吟诵铁与火的福音。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Pirate/Pirate.name: Hydroid
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pirate/Pirate.description: Hydroid summons the power of the ocean depths. He provides crowd control with aqueous attacks. His enemies will meet a watery demise.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pirate/Pirate.zhDescription: Hydroid 可以召唤海洋深处的力量。他通过水系攻击来提供群体控制。他的敌人将在水中消亡。

abilities.description: Summon a tempest to rain down upon a target area.
abilities.zhDescription: 召唤暴风雨弹炮轰目标区域。

abilities.description: Crash through enemies in a ferocious wall of water.
abilities.zhDescription: 用凶猛的水墙冲垮敌人。

abilities.description: Plunder Armor from nearby enemies and increase <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Damage on your Abilities and weapons. Enemies affected by <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Status offer a greater increase.
abilities.zhDescription: 从附近敌人身上掠夺护甲，并为你的技能和武器附加 <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀伤害。受到 <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀异常状态影响的敌人将提供更多加成。

abilities.description: Summon a creature from the depths. Its watery tentacles emerge from nearby surfaces to wreak havoc.
abilities.zhDescription: 召唤一只来自深海的生物。它的水之触手从四面八方席卷而来造成严重破坏。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Pirate/HydroidPrime.name: Hydroid Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pirate/HydroidPrime.description: Command the ocean's fury with this king of gold and silver. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pirate/HydroidPrime.zhDescription: 以这金银之王号令大海的怒涛。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

abilities.zhDescription: 召唤暴风雨弹炮轰目标区域。

abilities.zhDescription: 用凶猛的水墙冲垮敌人。

/Lotus/Powersuits/PaxDuviricus/PaxDuviri.name: Kullervo
/Lotus/Powersuits/PaxDuviricus/PaxDuviri.description: Kullervo answers for his sins and the sins of others. His daggers and melee prowess deal high damage. Seize the power of treachery to slake his thirst for revenge.
/Lotus/Powersuits/PaxDuviricus/PaxDuviri.zhDescription: Kullervo 背负着自己和他人的罪孽。他的匕首和近战能力可以造成高额伤害。抓住背叛的力量来满足他对复仇的渴望。

abilities.description:
(TAP) Kullervo charges a Heavy Attack, then teleports to his target and strikes. His rage-filled focus temporarily increases his Melee Critical Chance.
(HOLD) Teleport to any marked location.
abilities.zhDescription:
（轻按）Kullervo 为重击进行蓄力，然后传送至他的目标身边并发动攻击。他那充满愤怒的集中力会暂时增加他的近战暴击几率。
（长按）传送至任何标记的地点。

abilities.description: Kullervo surrounds himself with daggers. Each dagger that strikes an enemy restores his health, but each dagger that misses an enemy strikes Kullervo, dealing a bit of damage. When Kullervo has max Health, he receives Overguard from struck enemies.
abilities.zhDescription: Kullervo 用匕首包围自己。每一把击中敌人的匕首都会恢复他的生命值，但每一把未击中敌人的匕首都会攻击 Kullervo，对他造成少量伤害。Kullervo 拥有满生命值时，会在击中敌人时获得超宏防护。

abilities.description: Kullervo sends forth a curse that binds enemies. When a cursed enemy takes damage from him, every other cursed enemy also suffers a portion of that damage.
abilities.zhDescription: Kullervo 发出一道诅咒束缚住敌人。当一个被诅咒的敌人受到来自他的伤害时，其他被诅咒的敌人也会受到相应的一部分伤害。

abilities.description: The Void answers Kullervo's invocation with a storm of daggers that rain down upon his enemies.
abilities.zhDescription: 虚空以匕首雨的形式回应 Kullervo 的呼唤，向他的敌人倾泄。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Paladin/PaladinPrime.name: Oberon Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Paladin/PaladinPrime.description: Protect the balance with this regal forest guardian. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Paladin/PaladinPrime.zhDescription: 以这帝王般庄严的森林庇护者维系平衡。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

abilities.description: Focuses deadly energy within a target, dealing massive damage and removing all of its defenses, including Overguard. Enemies near the target also take a portion of the damage.
abilities.zhDescription: 将致命能量聚集于目标，造成巨大伤害并移除其所有防御，包括超宏防护。目标附近的敌人也会受到部分伤害。

abilities.description: Sanctifies the ground around Oberon, inflicting <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage to all enemies within the radius. Also grants protection against Status Effects for Oberon and his allies.
abilities.zhDescription: 圣化 Oberon 周围的地面，对范围内的所有敌人造成 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射伤害。同时保护 Oberon 及其友军免受异常状态影响。

abilities.description: Generates a protective aura that grants bonus Armor to Oberon and his allies and restores allies' Health over time. Healing is doubled while within the radius of Hallowed Ground.
abilities.zhDescription: 生成一道保护光环，为 Oberon 及其友军提供护甲加成，并持续恢复友军生命值。在「神圣领域」范围内，治疗效果翻倍。

abilities.description: Lifts enemies into the air and then hurls them down with conviction, removing their Armor. Enemies hit by this ability will grant Oberon additional Armor and have a chance to spawn a <HEALTH>Health Orb when they die.
abilities.zhDescription: 将附近的敌人迅速举到空中，然后将其狠狠摔下。被该技能击中的会为 Oberon 提供额外护甲，并在死亡时有几率掉落生命球。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Paladin/Paladin.name: Oberon
/Lotus/Powersuits/Paladin/Paladin.description: Healing and suffering do Oberon’s bidding. His command of the natural world supports allies. Boon to his friends, bane of his foes.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Paladin/Paladin.zhDescription: 愈合和苦痛皆为 Oberon 所驱使。他对自然界的驾驭能够支援友军。朋友之福，敌人之祸。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Pagemaster/Pagemaster.name: Dante
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pagemaster/Pagemaster.description: Seeker of knowledge. Keeper of history. Daring researcher of Leverian lore. Dante composes arcane tales to support allies and devastate enemies.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pagemaster/Pagemaster.zhDescription: 知识探求者。历史守护者。莱弗博物馆传说的勇敢学者。Dante 创作神秘的诗篇来支援队友并摧毁敌人。

abilities.description: Open Noctua, Dante's Exalted Tome, and unleash a tale of woe upon his enemies.
abilities.zhDescription: 翻开 Dante 的显赫典籍——夜枭，向他的敌人释放悲剧。

abilities.description: Dante's vitalizing composition grants him and his allies Overguard and restores their Health.
abilities.zhDescription: Dante 的活力之作赋予他和他的友军超宏防护，并恢复他们的生命值。

abilities.description: Dante's composition draws blood from nearby enemies, inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage upon them.
abilities.zhDescription: Dante 的诗句从周围敌人身上抽出血液，对他们造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割伤害。

abilities.description:
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. TRIUMPH: Two Light Verses cast in succession invigorate allies with a buff that increases Health and grants Overguard. Kills and assists briefly regenerate Overguard.
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. TRAGEDY: Two Dark Verses cast in succession attack enemies. Damage Over Time from Slash, Heat and Toxin Status Effects accumulates in a single blast.
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. WORDWARDEN: A Light Verse followed by a Dark Verse supports allies with copies of Noctua. Noctua copies synchronize their attacks with their designated ally's attacks.
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. PAGEFLIGHT: A Dark Verse followed by a Light Verse summons Paragrimms that swoop at enemies, making them vulnerable to Status Chance and Status Damage, as well as drawing enemy attacks away from allies.
abilities.zhDescription:
Dante 必须在他的「最终诗篇」之前创作另外两首诗句。 胜利：连续施放两个「明之诗句」能够振奋友军，为他们提供增加生命值并赋予超宏防护的增益效果。击杀和助攻会短暂恢复超宏防护。

Dante 必须在他的「最终诗篇」之前创作另外两首诗句。 书页飞羽：「暗之诗句」后跟着「明之诗句」可召唤幽幽鹰扑向敌人，使他们易受触发几率和异常状态伤害的影响，并将敌人的攻击从友军身上转移。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Pacifist/Pacifist.name: Baruuk
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pacifist/Pacifist.description: Beware the fury of the truly patient. Baruuk boasts survivability and crowd control. Pushed beyond his restraint, he unleashes the storm within.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pacifist/Pacifist.zhDescription: 不可小觑波澜不惊之人心中的怒火。Baruuk 拥有出色的生存能力和群体控制能力。当忍无可忍之时，这位不愿出手的大师就会释放其内在的暴怒。

abilities.description: Dodge all incoming projectiles, but only while not attacking. Use again to deactivate this ability.
abilities.zhDescription: 只处于没攻击时可闪避所有飞来的子弹。再使用一次可关闭该技能。

abilities.description: A calming wave slows enemies until they fall into a slumber. Enemies woken by damage will be confused and disoriented. Short-term amnesia means all waking enemies forget anything that happened before the lull.
abilities.zhDescription: 平静的波浪使敌人速度变慢直到陷入沉睡。被击伤而苏醒的敌人会感到困惑和迷失。短暂的健忘意味着所有醒来的敌人都会忘记沉睡之前所发生的任何事。

abilities.description: Summon a bevy of orbiting daggers to seek out enemy guns, destroying them with a small explosion. Combine with Elude to double the range.
abilities.zhDescription: 召唤一群环绕的匕首并寻找敌人的枪支，用小型爆炸来摧毁它们。与「巧躲」结合来使范围加倍。

abilities.description: With his Restraint eroded, Baruuk commands the Desert Wind to deliver powerful radial strikes with his fists and feet. Each moment commanding the storm restores his Restraint.
abilities.zhDescription: 随着他的「克制」被侵蚀，Baruuk 用「宁静风暴」来使拳脚作出强大的范围攻击。掌握风暴的每一刻会使他恢复「克制」。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Pacifist/BaruukPrime.name: Baruuk Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pacifist/BaruukPrime.description: Doomed are the fools who attack the peace and exhaust the restraint of this reluctant warrior.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Pacifist/BaruukPrime.zhDescription: 那些破坏和平，以及耗尽这位不愿出手的战士克制力的愚蠢之人注定会灭亡。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Oraxia/Oraxia.name: Oraxia
/Lotus/Powersuits/Oraxia/Oraxia.description: Sinister grace interwoven with lethal versatility; the evolution of a perfect predator. Fear's name is Oraxia.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Oraxia/Oraxia.zhDescription: 阴险优雅与致命多面性交织，进化为完美掠食者。恐惧之名，Oraxia。

abilities.description: Leap onto an enemy and pierce them with Oraxia's spider legs, dealing <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage. Enemies defeated by this attack have a chance to drop Health or Energy Orbs.
abilities.zhDescription: 跳到敌人身上，用 Oraxia 的蜘蛛腿刺穿他们，造成 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害。用这个攻击击败敌人时，他们将有几率掉落生命球或能量球。

abilities.description: Oraxia throws a creeping web to ensnare her prey. Enemies caught within the widening radius are trapped inside a cocoon that increases their Damage Vulnerability.
abilities.zhDescription: Oraxia 投掷一张蔓延的蛛网，将猎物困住。在不断扩大的蛛网中被捕住的敌人会被困在茧中，并使其受到的易伤效果增加。

abilities.description: Oraxia launches a barrage of stinging darts in front of her that applies <DT_POISON_COLOR> Toxin Status Effect. Poisoned enemies spawn Scuttlers when killed.
abilities.zhDescription: Oraxia 向她前方发射一连串带刺的飞镖，并施加 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素异常状态。中毒的敌人被击杀后会生成急行蛛。

abilities.description:
Unfurl Oraxia's spider legs and go on the prowl. Oraxia is immune to Status Effects and has increased Maximum Health. Ranged Weapons are imbued with <DT_POISON_COLOR> Toxin Damage. Killing enemies causes them to burst with <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin.

Silken Thread: Tap Dodge to leap to a targeted surface.
abilities.zhDescription:
展开 Oraxia 的蜘蛛腿，开始狩猎。Oraxia 免疫异常状态并提升最大生命值。她的远程武器充满 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害。击杀敌人会使其爆发 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素。

蛛丝游走：轻按冲刺即可跳跃至目标表面。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Odalisk/ProteaPrime.name: Protea Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Odalisk/ProteaPrime.description: Behold the child of two fathers. Protea Prime once fulfilled Parvos Granum's vision of a time-wielding guardian. Now she upholds the Tenno ideal of defending the defenseless.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Odalisk/ProteaPrime.zhDescription: 看这位双父之女。Protea Prime 曾实现帕尔沃斯·格拉努关于操纵时间守护者的愿景。现在，她秉承 Tenno 的理念，保护手无寸铁之人。

abilities.description:
Throw out grenades in an arc.

(TAP) SHRAPNEL VORTEX
Creates a slashing, staggering swirl of shrapnel.

(HOLD) SHIELD SATELLITES
Protea reconfigures Grenades to work as overcharging shield generators, protecting her, her allies and companions. When Shields break, a Satellite is destroyed to double minimum Shield Gate invincibility time.
abilities.zhDescription:
投掷弧线飞行的手雷。

（轻按）破片漩涡
产生一道锋利无比的弹片漩涡。

（长按）护盾卫星
Protea 重设手雷，使其变为超载护盾充能器，以保护她自身、她的友军和同伴。当 Protea 的护盾被击穿时，一台守护她的卫星会被摧毁以加倍延长其最小护盾保险的无敌时间。

abilities.description: Deploys an artillery unit to blast plasma charges at enemies it faces. Each enemy hit increases the power of subsequent plasma attacks.
abilities.zhDescription: 部署一个火炮单位来向其面向的敌人发射炸裂的等离子电浆。每击中一名敌人都会增加后续等离子攻击的威力。

abilities.description: Deploys a device that generates 3 pickups after a short delay: empowered health orb, universal ammo pack and energy orb.
abilities.zhDescription: 部署一个装置，片刻之后可产生 3 种拾取物：强化生命球、通用弹药补给包和能量球。

abilities.description:
Drops a Temporal Anchor which, after a short duration, Protea rewinds to trigger a temporal implosion. Implosion damage increases based on damage dealt between anchor drop and rewind. Everything lost or expended in that time is returned.
Dying while Anchor is active rewinds Protea to the anchor, saving her. Protea is knocked down and the anchor vanishes.
abilities.zhDescription:
放置一个「时泊之锚」后的一段时间，Protea 可以把这段时间回溯，来触发一个时空内爆。该内爆伤害会根据从 Protea 放置「时泊之锚」的时候起到回溯的时候为止，这段时间造成的伤害而增加。在此期间丢失或使用的任何物品都会被退还给玩家。
在「时泊之锚」被激活状态时死亡的话，启用回溯会使 Protea 回到过去，从而使其免于死亡。Protea 仍会处于击倒状态，而「时泊之锚」也会消失。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Odalisk/Odalisk.name: Protea
/Lotus/Powersuits/Odalisk/Odalisk.description: Protea knows all about protection. Her vast arsenal inflicts damage and provides ally support. She can even manipulate time itself.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Odalisk/Odalisk.zhDescription: Protea 对保护了如指掌。她庞大的武器库可以造成伤害并为友军提供支援。她甚至可以操纵时间本身。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Nokko/Nokko.name: Nokko
/Lotus/Powersuits/Nokko/Nokko.description: Spring into action with Nokko! With his strong roots and an array of tricky fungi this young defender will quickly grow on you
/Lotus/Powersuits/Nokko/Nokko.zhDescription: 和 Nokko 一起行动起来！这位年轻的守护者拥有强大的根系和各种古灵精怪的真菌，很快就会扎根在你的心里

abilities.description: Throw a mushroom that periodically sheds poisonous spores, inflicting <DT_VIRAL_COLOR> Viral Damage and Status Effect upon nearby enemies while also lulling them to sleep.
abilities.zhDescription: 扔出一个周期性释放有毒孢子的蘑菇，对附近的敌人造成 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害和异常状态，同时使他们陷入睡眠状态。

abilities.description: Release a rejuvenating mushroom that emits a radial pulse, giving Nokko and his allies' <ENERGY> Energy and applying a buff to Ability Strength that lasts for a short time.
abilities.zhDescription: 释放一个可以发出放射脉冲波的复苏蘑菇，给予 Nokko 及其友军 <ENERGY> 能量，并在短时间内对技能强度施加增益。

abilities.description: Revert to Sprodling form, spawning orbs that heal Nokko and grant a speed boost. While in this state, Nokko is untargetable and heals gradually.
abilities.zhDescription: 恢复为菌宝形态，生成使 Nokko 快速愈合和加速的球体。在此状态下，Nokko 无法被选为攻击目标并且会逐渐恢复。

abilities.description: Unleash a chaotic ballistic mushroom that seeks enemies and bounces explosively off whatever it touches. Contact with any of Nokko’s mushrooms invigorates them, doubling their pulse rate.
abilities.zhDescription: 释放一个混乱的弹道蘑菇，会追踪敌人并在触碰目标后爆炸反弹。接触 Nokko 的任何蘑菇都会使其活化，脉冲频率翻倍。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Ninja/Ninja.name: Ash
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ninja/Ninja.description: Behold the patron saint of the Orokin school of political assassination. Ash specializes in stealth. The edge of his blade is sooner felt than seen.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ninja/Ninja.zhDescription: 看那奥罗金政治刺杀学派的先师圣人。 Ash 擅长潜行。还没见其刀光，就已命归黄泉。

abilities.description: Launches a spinning blade of pain, dealing high damage and impaling enemies to walls.
abilities.zhDescription: 掷出一枚旋转的手里剑，造成高伤害并把敌人钉在墙上。

abilities.description: Drops a smoke bomb that stuns enemies and obscures their vision, rendering Ash invisible for a short time.
abilities.zhDescription: 扔出烟雾弹眩晕敌人并阻碍其视线，同时 Ash 进入短暂的隐身状态。

abilities.description: Teleport to a target and perform a Finisher. If the finisher kills the target, Ash regains a portion of the energy spent.
abilities.zhDescription: 瞬移至目标并进行处决。如果处决击杀目标，将为 Ash 恢复一部分消耗的能量。

abilities.description: Project fierce Shadow Clones of Ash upon groups of distant enemies. Join the fray using Teleport. The Shadow Clones can be upgraded with mods.
abilities.zhDescription: 将 Ash 的凶猛影分身投入远处的敌群中。使用「瞬移」可以主动加入这场厮杀。幻影分身可通过 Mod 来升级。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Ninja/AshPrime.name: Ash Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ninja/AshPrime.description: Distraction and subterfuge become lethal weapons with Ash Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ninja/AshPrime.zhDescription: 以狂乱与诡计成为致命武器的 Ash Prime。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Nezha/NezhaPrime.name: Nezha Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Nezha/NezhaPrime.description: Behold: the Scion of the Burning Wind, now before you in most courtly accoutrement. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Nezha/NezhaPrime.zhDescription: 看呐：灼烧之风的后嗣，现在身披最典雅的战袍，出现在你面前。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

abilities.description: Blaze a trail of flames, scorching enemies and cleansing allies. Teleporting blasts the landing area with a ring of fire.
abilities.zhDescription: 点燃一道火焰的路径，烧灼敌人并净化友军。传送时可在落地点产生火圈爆破。

abilities.description: Hurl a flaming ring that sets enemies ablaze making them vulnerable to any damage. Flaming enemies drop Restorative Orbs on death. Charge to amplify the power of the ring, and reactivate to instantly travel to the ring's location.
abilities.zhDescription: 掷出一个可点燃敌人的火圈，使敌人更易受到伤害。燃烧的敌人可掉落恢复球。蓄力可增强火圈的力量，再次激活技能可瞬间传送至火圈的位置。

abilities.description: Create a protective ring of fire, that also stuns and damages enemies who get too close.
abilities.zhDescription: 制造出守护火环，对靠近的敌人造成伤害并晕眩。

abilities.description: Impale nearby enemies on spears that erupt from the below. Activate again to slam surviving enemies back into the ground.
abilities.zhDescription: 用破地而出的长矛将附近的敌人刺起。再次使用技能可以将幸存的敌人猛拍回地面。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Nezha/Nezha.description: The mercurial firemonger protects the innocent. Nezha’s multifaceted tactics give him high survivability as he inflicts damage and provides crowd control. His fire is the clarion of hope.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Nezha/Nezha.zhDescription: 机敏善变的驭火行家保护无辜者。 Nezha 多面化的战术使他在伤害和提供群体控制时具有很高的生存能力。他的火焰是希望的号角。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Necro/NekrosPrime.description: Death's new master. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Necro/NekrosPrime.zhDescription: 死亡的新主人。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

abilities.description: A blow so powerful, it turns the enemy's very soul into a deadly projectile, damaging all in its path. Enemies that survive the blow are Marked for Harvest and become one of Nekros' Shadows of the Dead if killed while marked.
abilities.zhDescription: 如此强烈的打击，把敌人的灵魂化为致命弹头，来杀伤其经过路线上的一切。在这一击中幸存下来的敌人会被标记以待收割，如果敌人在处于标记时被杀死，他就会成为 Nekros「亡者幽影」中的一员。

abilities.description: Cast fear into the hearts of nearby enemies, causing them to run away in terror.
abilities.zhDescription: 将恐惧感深植周遭敌人心中，使他们于恐惧之中逃窜。

abilities.description: Forces fallen enemies around you to drop additional loot.
abilities.zhDescription: 亵渎亡者尸体，从中搜取额外物品。

abilities.description: Summon shadow versions of vanquished enemies to fight alongside you for a short period.
abilities.zhDescription: 召唤战死敌人的幽影在短时间内一起作战。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Necro/Necro.name: Nekros
/Lotus/Powersuits/Necro/Necro.description: There is a reaper whose name is Nekros. He provides deathly crowd control. Erstwhile enemies become allies when Nekros calls up recruits from the dead.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Necro/Necro.zhDescription: 有一个收割者，他的名字叫 Nekros。他提供致命的群体控制。当 Nekros 从死者中召唤新兵时，昔日的敌人就会变成盟友。

abilities.description: A blow so powerful, it turns the enemy's very soul into a deadly projectile, damaging all in its path. Enemies that survive the blow are Marked for Harvest and become one of Nekros' Shadows of the Dead if killed while marked.
abilities.zhDescription: 如此强烈的打击，把敌人的灵魂化为致命弹头，来杀伤其经过路线上的一切。在这一击中幸存下来的敌人会被标记以待收割，如果敌人在处于标记时被杀死，他就会成为 Nekros「亡者幽影」中的一员。

abilities.description: Cast fear into the hearts of nearby enemies, causing them to run away in terror.
abilities.zhDescription: 将恐惧感深植周遭敌人心中，使他们于恐惧之中逃窜。

abilities.description: Forces fallen enemies around you to drop additional loot.
abilities.zhDescription: 亵渎亡者尸体，从中搜取额外物品。

abilities.description: Summon shadow versions of vanquished enemies to fight alongside you for a short period.
abilities.zhDescription: 召唤战死敌人的幽影在短时间内一起作战。

/Lotus/Powersuits/MonkeyKing/WukongPrime.name: Wukong Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/MonkeyKing/WukongPrime.description: The trickster-warrior ascends to his ultimate incarnation.
/Lotus/Powersuits/MonkeyKing/WukongPrime.zhDescription: 恶作剧战士提升到了他的最终形态。

abilities.description:
Shedding part of himself, Wukong creates a twin to fight by his side. Attack at range and the twin will melee, pull a blade and the twin will lay down covering fire.
Use again to command the twin to attack a target with increased damage.
abilities.zhDescription:
Wukong 拔出一根毫毛，以此来制造出一个共同作战的分身。本体使用远程攻击时，分身就会发动近战攻击，而当本体拔出刀剑之时，分身则会进行掩护射击。
再次使用技能即可命令分身对某个目标发动强化攻击。

abilities.description: Evaporate into a cloud of mist and float through the battlefield, dazing any enemies encountered, while healing Wukong and his twin.
abilities.zhDescription: 化身为一团云雾，飘过战场，在令沿途的敌人陷入眩晕的同时治疗 Wukong 和他的分身。

abilities.description:
Wukong and his twin become invulnerable and defy enemies to attack. All damage is captured, stored, and dealt back in a single furious strike of Wukong's staff.
Bonus Armor is then granted relative to the damage captured.
abilities.zhDescription:
Wukong 和他的分身进入无敌状态，同时嘲讽敌人，吸引火力。在此期间受到的所有伤害都会被积攒起来，而后 Wukong 会以一记狂怒的棍击将其释放。
根据积攒的伤害量，Wukong 还会得到额外护甲。

abilities.description: Summon the iron staff and unleash fury.
abilities.zhDescription: 召唤出定海神针并释放猴王的怒火。

/Lotus/Powersuits/MonkeyKing/MonkeyKing.name: Wukong
/Lotus/Powersuits/MonkeyKing/MonkeyKing.description: The simian warrior is a mountain of strength. Wukong deals heavy damage and has high survivability. His quick trickster tactics are unforgettable.
/Lotus/Powersuits/MonkeyKing/MonkeyKing.zhDescription: 猴族战士力拔山兮气盖世。Wukong 能够造成巨大的伤害并具备强大的生存能力。他灵活多变的恶作剧战术让人难忘。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Magician/Magician.name: Limbo
/Lotus/Powersuits/Magician/Magician.description: Master the rift between shadow and substance. Limbo disrupts time-space to provide crowd control. He is at home where others struggle with what is real.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Magician/Magician.zhDescription: 他掌握着影子与物质之间的裂隙。 Limbo 通过扰乱时空来进行群体控制。这是他的主场，其余人都将沉沦于虚实之间。

abilities.description: Casts a wave of Rift energy that damages hostiles while pushing enemies and allies out of Limbo's current plane of existence.
abilities.zhDescription: 释放一道裂隙能量波来伤害敌人，同时将敌人与队友从 Limbo 目前所在的位面中推出去。

abilities.description: Freezes Rift-bound enemies. While active, enemy projectiles are arrested in mid-air, resuming its trajectory when stasis ends.
abilities.zhDescription: 使被裂隙束缚的敌人静止。当其激活时，敌人的子弹将会被截停在半空中，停滞结束后这些子弹将会按照原先的弹道继续行进。

abilities.description: Surges nearby Rift-bound enemies with Rift energy. When killed the Rift Surge is transferred to a nearby enemy outside the rift. Surged enemies that leave the Rift perform a radial Banish.
abilities.zhDescription: 用裂隙能量涌流冲击附近被裂隙困住的敌人。被击杀时裂隙涌流会被传递到涌流外的一名附近的敌人上。被涌流影响的敌人若离开裂隙，将会引起一个范围​​放逐。

abilities.description: A violent blast of Void energy tears open a pocket of rift plane which can sustain itself for a short period before collapsing in another lethal blast.
abilities.zhDescription: 借由虚空能量的猛烈爆炸撕开一个裂隙位面空间，此空间能短暂持续至下一次致命爆炸发生。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Magician/LimboPrime.name: Limbo Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Magician/LimboPrime.description: Dance between realms with this golden rift walker. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Magician/LimboPrime.zhDescription: 用这金色的裂隙行者起舞于不同的领域。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Mag/MagPrime.name: Mag Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Mag/MagPrime.description: The exquisite Mag Prime offers the same abilities as Mag but with unique mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Mag/MagPrime.zhDescription: 精巧的 Mag Prime 拥有与 Mag 一样的技能，但自带独特的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

abilities.description: Mag stuns enemies as she manifests a magnetic vortex. The vortex pulls in Polarize Shards and stunned enemies to place them directly in front of her.
abilities.zhDescription: Mag 所制造出的磁力漩涡会晕眩敌人。漩涡会将「护盾极化碎片」和被震晕的敌人拉近，并将他们放置在她面前。

abilities.description:
(TAP) Enclose a target in a magnetic field that ensnares nearby enemies and deals damage over time. The field pulls Polarize Shards that orbited Mag and shrapnel into the deadly mix.
(HOLD) Mag surrounds herself in a magnetic field that absorbs ranged attacks and reflects damage back in a destructive cone.
abilities.zhDescription:
（轻按）将目标封闭在磁场中，在一段时间内困住附近的敌人，并对其造成伤害。该磁场会吸引环绕 Mag 运动的「护盾极化碎片」和飞溅的弹片进行致命混合。
（长按）Mag 将自己包裹在一个磁场中，吸收远程攻击，并在一个破坏性锥型域内返还伤害。

abilities.description: Emit an energy pulse that depletes enemy shields and armor as it restores ally shields. Debris left over from the pulse becomes Polarize Shards. Nearby Polarize Shards orbit Mag and cut enemies, inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effect.
abilities.zhDescription: 发射一道能量脉冲，在耗尽敌人护盾和护甲的同时恢复队友护盾。脉冲留下的碎片会形成「护盾极化碎片」。附近的「护盾极化碎片」会环绕 Mag 并切割敌人，造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。

abilities.description: Magnetize the bones of nearby enemies, causing them to collapse upon themselves.
abilities.zhDescription: 磁化附近的敌军的骨头，导致它们自我崩坏。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Mag/Mag.name: Mag
/Lotus/Powersuits/Mag/Mag.description: Take down your enemies with magnetic force. Mag alters magnetic fields to provide crowd control and strip enemy defenses. Few can resist her attraction or her repulsion.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Mag/Mag.zhDescription: 运用磁力击倒你的敌人。Mag 通过改变磁场来提供群体控制，同时削减敌人的防御力。几乎无人能抵挡她的吸引力或排斥力。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Loki/LokiPrime.name: Loki Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Loki/LokiPrime.description: Confuse, deceive and destroy with Loki Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Loki/LokiPrime.zhDescription: 混淆、误导与破坏是 Loki Prime 的代名词。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

abilities.description: Loki deploys a holographic copy of himself that draws enemy fire. The decoy gains health and shield based on enemies nearby.
abilities.zhDescription: Loki 会部署一个自己的全息复制体来吸引敌人的火力。分身会根据附近敌人的数量获得生命值和护盾。

abilities.description: Loki camouflages himself, becoming invisible to enemies.
abilities.zhDescription: Loki伪装自身，让自己在敌人面前隐形。

abilities.description: Loki instantaneously swaps positions with a target, confusing the enemy.
abilities.zhDescription: Loki瞬间和目标交换位置，迷惑敌人。

abilities.description: Lets forth a wave of energy, disrupting the projectile weapons of enemies in range and forcing them to revert to melee combat.
abilities.zhDescription: 释放一道能量波，解除范围内敌人的射击武器，迫使他们使用近战。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Loki/Loki.name: Loki
/Lotus/Powersuits/Loki/Loki.description: Loki knows the art of deception. The trickster employs stealth to sabotage enemies. Sow confusion.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Loki/Loki.zhDescription: Loki 精通欺骗的艺术。恶作剧者利用隐身来袭击敌人。制造混乱吧。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Koumei/Koumei.name: Koumei
/Lotus/Powersuits/Koumei/Koumei.description: Test your luck with the dice-maiden. Koumei weaves fate to unleash damage and ensure her survival. To the virtuous, she is an oracle. To the wicked, a perilous game of chance.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Koumei/Koumei.zhDescription: 让掷骰巫女试试你的运气。命运编织者 Koumei 攻守兼备。对有德之人，她将带来启示；对奸邪之人，她是一场危险的博弈。

abilities.description:
Weave the threads of destiny. Enemies who touch the threads suffer a random Elemental Status Effect.

A roll of triple sixes creates threads that inflict one of every Elemental Status Effect.
abilities.zhDescription:
编织命运之线。触碰命运之线的敌人会受到随机元素异常状态的影响。

投掷出三个六点会产生可以造成所有元素异常状态的线。

abilities.description:
Koumei glimpses a favorable future and the precise steps needed to reach it. Complete the challenge to earn a Decree. Unlucky rolls add a debuff, but you can hold the ability to reject the Omikuji.

A roll of triple sixes grants a Decree without a challenge.
abilities.zhDescription:
Koumei 预视到了一个美好的未来以及实现它的具体步骤。完成挑战即可获得王令。运气不好的掷骰结果会带来一种减益，但你可以长按技能键以放弃该御神签。

掷出三个六则可以直接获得王令，无需挑战。

abilities.description:
Surround yourself with Omamori Charms, each with a chance to have enemy attacks heal you instead of damage you. The number of charms is determined by Koumei's dice roll.

A roll of triple sixes grants invulnerability for the duration of your Omamori Charms.
abilities.zhDescription:
让御守护符围绕自己，每个护符都有机会使敌人的攻击治愈你，而非伤害你。护符的数量取决于 Koumei 的掷骰结果。

掷出三个六则在御守护符激活期间获得无敌效果。

abilities.description:
Wield your foe’s fate threads like the strings of marionettes. Koumei’s dice determine how many Status Effects foes in front of Koumei will suffer.

A roll of triple sixes causes further Status Effects over time and extends Bunraku to enemies behind Koumei.
abilities.zhDescription:
像操纵牵线木偶一样操纵敌人的命运之线。Koumei 的骰子决定了 Koumei 面前的敌人将承受的异常状态数量。

掷出三个六会造成持续的额外异常状态，并将人偶戏效果延伸到 Koumei 背后的敌人。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/KhoraPrime.name: Khora Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/KhoraPrime.description: A harmony of mistress and monster. The gilded huntress and her loyal Kavat, Venari, dominate the battlefield with their will.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/KhoraPrime.zhDescription: 女能手和怪物的默契配合。镀金女猎手与她忠诚的库娃——薇娜丽，以她们的意志统治着战场。

abilities.description: Send enemies reeling with a deafening whipcrack. Stats are boosted by the equipped mods on Whipclaw.
abilities.zhDescription: 在欲聋的鞭打声中将敌人击退。装备在「长鞭利爪」的 Mod 可以增强技能威力。

abilities.description: Bind a hapless target in living metal, entangling others who stray too close. Whipclaw will refresh the trap allowing it to capture more enemies.
abilities.zhDescription: 使用活性金属来束缚住一名倒霉的目标，并将缠绕过度靠近的敌人。以长鞭利爪击打可以刷新陷阱来捆绑更多敌人。

abilities.description: Command Venari to focus on a target. Hold to cycle between Attack, Protect, and Heal postures. If Venari is killed, use this ability to revive her instantly.
abilities.zhDescription: 命令薇娜丽专注于一名目标；按住技能来切换攻击，保护和治疗形态；若薇娜丽阵亡，使用此技能可以立即复活她。

abilities.description: Weave a dome of living chain that ensnares and strangles any enemy within, and any foolish enough to approach. Foes outside the trap will try to hasten their comrade's deaths by shooting them. Crack Whipclaw on the dome to further damage any trapped enemies.
abilities.zhDescription: 编织出一张活动的锁链穹顶，禁锢并勒住其中的敌人和胆敢接近的蠢货。在穹顶外部的敌人会借由试着射击他们的同袍来加速其死亡；使用长鞭利爪击打穹顶可使其伤害遍及至任何被困住的敌人身上。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/Khora.name: Khora
/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/Khora.description: Khora is red in whip and claw. She works together with her Kavat companion, Venari, to deal high damage and provide crowd control. Two bodies, one will.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Khora/Khora.zhDescription: Khora 有着血染的鞭子和爪子。她与她的库娃同伴薇娜丽，合力造成高伤害并提供群体控制。双身同心。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Jade/NyxPrime.name: Nyx Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Jade/NyxPrime.description: Infiltrate the minds of your enemies with Nyx Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Jade/NyxPrime.zhDescription: 通过 Nyx Prime 来渗透进敌人的精神中。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

abilities.description: Nyx seizes control of a target's mind, compelling them to fight for the Tenno cause. Controlled enemies have increased <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status Chance. When Nyx shoots them, they also have an increased Damage Multiplier.
abilities.zhDescription: Nyx 控制目标的思想，迫使他们为 Tenno 效力。被控制的敌人会增加 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射触发几率。当 Nyx 射击他们时，伤害倍率也会增加。

abilities.description: Nyx unleashes a volley of psychic bolts that track and strike nearby enemies with telekinetic precision. When enemies are slain, additional bolts scatter to new targets. Striking foes weakens their defenses and transfers a portion to Nyx.
abilities.zhDescription: Nyx 释放出一连串精神飞刃，通过意念操控来精准追踪并攻击附近的敌人。击杀敌人后，额外的飞刃会散射到新的目标上。命中敌人会削弱他们的防御，并将一部分防御转移给 Nyx。

abilities.description: Nyx releases a devastating psychic pulse, disorienting enemies in a wide radius and forcing them to turn on each other. Confused foes lash out at random factions.
abilities.zhDescription: Nyx 释放毁灭性的精神脉冲，使大范围内的敌人迷失方向，并迫使他们自相残杀。困惑的敌人会随机攻击不同派系。

abilities.description: Nyx draws in and contains the damage dealt to her and the damage confused enemies deal to each other then converts it into a devastating radial blast. Following the blast, she enters a brief invulnerable state and gains a Weapon Damage boost proportional to the absorbed damage.
abilities.zhDescription: Nyx 吸收对她造成的伤害，以及困惑的敌人之间造成的伤害，然后将其转化为一道毁灭性的范围爆炸。爆炸后，她将进入短暂的无敌状态，并根据吸收的伤害增加武器伤害。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Jade/Jade.name: Nyx
/Lotus/Powersuits/Jade/Jade.description: Psychic attacks make Nyx a dangerous foe. She reaches into enemy consciousness to provide crowd control and turn their attacks back on them. Such manipulation can turn the tide of battle.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Jade/Jade.zhDescription: Nyx 的精神攻击使她成为一个危险的对手。她通过触及敌人的意识来进行群体控制，并将他们的攻击转向他们自己。这种操纵可以扭转战局。

/Lotus/Powersuits/IronFrame/IronFramePri.name: Hildryn Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/IronFrame/IronFramePri.description: Hildryn Prime proves that power is discipline’s reward.
/Lotus/Powersuits/IronFrame/IronFramePri.zhDescription: Hildryn Prime 证明了权力是纪律的回报。

abilities.description: Charge and launch devastating bolts of electricity.
abilities.zhDescription: 蓄力并迸发毁灭性的闪电。

abilities.description: Pillage a percentage of Shields and Armor of nearby enemies to replenish Hildryn's own Shields and Overshields. Also removes Status Effects from Hildryn and her allies.
abilities.zhDescription: 掠夺邻近敌人一定比例的护盾与装甲，用以补充自身的护盾与超载护盾。这也会移除 Hildryn 和她队友的异常状态。

abilities.description: Create a shield aura around allies. Enemies that approach Hildryn will take <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage.
abilities.zhDescription: 在友军周围创造一道护盾光环。敌人会在靠近 Hildryn 时受到 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射伤害。

abilities.description: Take the skies and rain Balefire rockets down on the enemy. Nearby enemies are blasted into the air where they will create an Energy Orb every few seconds. When shields run out the enemies are smashed into the ground.
abilities.zhDescription: 升上天空并对敌人降下野火火箭。附近的敌人会被炸向空中，且每隔数秒就会在他们身上生成一颗能量球。当护盾耗尽后敌人将被摔回地面。

/Lotus/Powersuits/IronFrame/IronFrame.name: Hildryn
/Lotus/Powersuits/IronFrame/IronFrame.description: Strength is Hildryn's virtue. Her unique high-damage abilities are powered by her Shields, which can be recharged with Energy. Hildryn proves that a strong offense is a good defense.
/Lotus/Powersuits/IronFrame/IronFrame.zhDescription: 强韧就是 Hildryn 的长处。Hildryn 可从吸收自身护盾以提供能量给技能所用，同时能量亦可再次充能护盾。Hildryn 证明了优秀的进攻就是最佳的防守。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Inkblot/Inkblot.name: Follie
/Lotus/Powersuits/Inkblot/Inkblot.description: Follie, the merry, macabre Shadowgrapher, brings ink to life. Support her squad and control enemy crowds with a myriad of versatile sketches and tricks.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Inkblot/Inkblot.zhDescription: 欢愉而可怕的绘影者 Follie 赋予墨水生命。她能通过千变万化的素描与戏法来支援小队，并控制敌群。

abilities.description: Drop through an inky frame and emerge invulnerable at the aimed location in a splash of ink that inflicts Inkblot on nearby enemies.
abilities.zhDescription: 穿过墨色框架，在目标地点以无敌的飞溅的墨汁出现，对附近敌人施加墨蚀效果。

abilities.description:
Bring shadowgraphs from Follie's sketchbook to life as items that can be used for tactical advantage. Shadowgraphs splash Inkblot onto nearby enemies when created.

HOLD to open the Shadowgraph gear wheel.
abilities.zhDescription:
将 Follie 绘影集中的绘影图变为具有战术优势的道具。绘影图生成时会向附近敌人施加墨蚀效果。

长按可打开绘影图轮盘。

abilities.description: Draw an ink effigy to absorb the damage dealt to Follie and allies. Below, a pool of ink spreads Inkblot. Kill enemies inside the pool to grow Follie's effigy and its ink puddle.
abilities.zhDescription: 绘制墨像来吸收 Follie 和友军所受的伤害。下方墨池挥洒出墨蚀效果。击杀墨池内的敌人可使 Follie 的墨像及墨池的规模不断扩大。

abilities.description: Tie nearby enemies to floating balloons that douse them with Inkblot. Pop the balloons to send them crashing to the ground, splashing damage on nearby enemies.
abilities.zhDescription: 将附近的敌人绑在漂浮的气球上，气球会向他们喷洒墨蚀。戳破气球，敌人会坠落到地面，飞溅的墨汁会对附近的敌人造成伤害。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Infestation/Infestatio.name: Nidus Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Infestation/Infestatio.description: Mutation is endless. The ravening plague-bearer returns in a long-unseen form, seething with a primal strain of the Infestation.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Infestation/Infestatio.zhDescription: 永无止境的突变。贪婪的瘟疫之源以远古之形带着原始感染菌株咆哮而来。

abilities.description: Rupture the ground with a damaging fungal growth that steals energy from each enemy it strikes. For every five enemies hit, the Infestation mutates, multiplying its destructive force.
abilities.zhDescription: 地面瞬间迸裂出有害的菌状生长物，从被击中的每个敌人身上吸取能量。每击中五名敌人便会使感染突变，倍化其破坏力。

abilities.description: Spawn an Infested pod that erupts with tendrils, latches onto nearby enemies and pulls them in. Enemies killed while held have a chance of generating a Mutation stack.
abilities.zhDescription: 生成一个迸裂出卷须的感染荚囊，紧抓附近的敌人并把他们拖入其中。在此期间被杀死的敌人有几率产生一层突变适性。

abilities.description: Bind to a target with parasitic link. When cast on an ally, both the host and Nidus have their Ability Strength and Weapon Damage increased. Linked enemies take some of the damage inflicted on Nidus.
abilities.zhDescription: 以寄生链接绑定目标。施展对象为友军时，Nidus 与宿主的技能强度和武器伤害都会提升；连结至敌方时，宿主可为 Nidus 承受部分伤害。

abilities.description: Gluttonous maggots swarm nearby enemies, feasting until they are hit with Virulence and burst with Infestation. The maggots benefit from Mutation and each enemy hit adds to the Mutation stack.
abilities.zhDescription: 异常贪婪的蛆虫群包围敌人并据以为食，直到敌人被「致病力」命中并在身上爆发感染为止。突变适性对蛆虫有增益效果，而每击中一名敌人会增加突变适性的累积。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Infestation/Infestatio.name: Nidus
/Lotus/Powersuits/Infestation/Infestatio.description: Nidus draws strength from the Infestation. It bolsters him with survivability as he deals high damage and provides crowd control. Plague your enemies.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Infestation/Infestatio.zhDescription: Nidus 从感染者中获得力量，以此造成高伤害和提供群体控制，增强了其生存能力。给你的敌人带来瘟疫吧。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Hoplite/StyanaxPrime.name: Styanax Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Hoplite/StyanaxPrime.description: Shield of the innocent. Spear of justice. Styanax Prime holds the line in defiance of tyranny.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Hoplite/StyanaxPrime.zhDescription: 无罪之盾，正义之矛。Styanax Prime 坚守阵线，对抗暴政。

abilities.description: Throw an Axios Javelin. When the javelin impales an enemy against a wall, surrounding enemies are pulled into the area and suffer a burst of damage.
abilities.zhDescription: 投掷一支崇敬标枪。当标枪将敌人钉在墙上时，周围的敌人会被拉近并遭受爆发式伤害。

abilities.description: Summon Tharros, the shield of Styanax. Swing Tharros to repel enemies and reduce their shields and armor. Styanax regenerates health for every enemy struck.
abilities.zhDescription: 召唤豪勇，Styanax 之盾。挥舞豪勇击退敌人并减少他们的护盾和护甲。每击中一名敌人，Styanax 都会恢复生命值。

abilities.description: Draw enemy attention to Styanax. His resolve uplifts him and nearby allies, regenerating the squad's energy over time. Styanax and his allies also regenerate shields for every kill assist they contribute.
abilities.zhDescription: 将敌人的注意力引向 Styanax。他的决心会鼓舞附近的友军和自己，使其随时间恢复能量。Styanax 和他的队友每次杀敌助攻都会恢复护盾。

abilities.description: Exude might and valor. Rise into the air and throw a barrage of Axios Javelins. The javelins deal damage to nearby enemies wherever they land. Direct hits to enemies deal greater damage.
abilities.zhDescription: 彰显力量与勇气。跃至空中并连续投掷崇敬标枪。标枪无论是否落地都可以对附近的敌人造成伤害。直接命中敌人将造成更高伤害。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Hoplite/Hoplite.name: Styanax
/Lotus/Powersuits/Hoplite/Hoplite.description: Styanax never wonders how many enemies he will face, only where he can find them. The hoplite deals high damage. Enemies tremble before his spear and shield.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Hoplite/Hoplite.zhDescription: Styanax 从不去想他要面对多少敌人，他只在乎能在何处找到他们。重装步兵可造成高额伤害。在他的长矛和盾牌的威力下，敌人闻风丧胆。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Harlequin/MiragePrime.name: Mirage Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Harlequin/MiragePrime.description: Dazzle the opposition with this golden master of illusion and mayhem. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Harlequin/MiragePrime.zhDescription: 用这位精通幻术和破坏的金色大师来扰乱对手吧。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

abilities.description: Mirage creates an entourage of doppelgangers to confuse and distract the enemy.
abilities.zhDescription: Mirage 创造随行的分身以混淆视听并引开敌人。

abilities.description: Booby trap nearby objects while conjuring an irresistible jewel that bursts with radial blind when touched in darkness, or a radial explosion in light. Conjure multiple smaller jewels with the help of Hall of Mirrors.
abilities.zhDescription: 将附近物品变成诡雷的同时变出一个令敌人难以抗拒的宝石。在黑暗处触碰宝石会爆裂造成范围致盲，在光亮处则产生范围爆炸。通过镜厅的帮助能施放出数个小宝石。

abilities.description:
(TAP) Temporarily reduce the damage Mirage takes from enemies.
(HOLD) Temporarily increase Mirage's weapon damage.
abilities.zhDescription:
（短按）暂时减少敌人对 Mirage 造成的伤害。
（长按）暂时增加 Mirage 的武器伤害。

abilities.description: Fires an energy prism that shoots lasers in all directions. Activating again detonates the prism, blinding nearby foes.
abilities.zhDescription: 放出一个四处发射激光的能量球。再次激活此技能可以引爆炸弹，并致盲附近的敌人。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Harlequin/Harlequin.name: Mirage
/Lotus/Powersuits/Harlequin/Harlequin.description: Mirage’s sleight of hand complements her might. Her dazzled foes take heavy damage. Doppelgangers, lasers, and traps are elements of her stagecraft.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Harlequin/Harlequin.zhDescription: Mirage 的戏法与她的实力相得益彰。被她搞得晕头转向的敌人会受到严重伤害。分身、激光和陷阱是她舞台艺术的要素。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Gyre/GyrePrime.name: Gyre Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Gyre/GyrePrime.description: Gilded circuits spark and energize frenetic movements that echo through the ages. Dance into eternity with Gyre Prime.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Gyre/GyrePrime.zhDescription: 镀金电路闪烁着能量，驱动着穿越时空的狂乱舞步。与 Gyre Prime 一起舞向永恒。

abilities.description: Launch a Gyratory Sphere that will deal high damage on impact and periodically deal electrical shocks to nearby enemies. Hit multiple enemies at once with the initial launch to enhance damage.
abilities.zhDescription: 发射一颗回旋球体，在撞击时造成大量伤害，并且可以定期对周围的敌人产生电击。在初始发射时一次性击中多名敌人来提升伤害。

abilities.description: Throw forward a Gyratory Sphere that will implode after a few seconds or can be manually triggered.
abilities.zhDescription: 扔出一颗会在几秒后向内爆炸的回旋球体，或是手动触发。

abilities.description: Gain a brief burst of increased Critical Chance and Energy Regen, with each kill extending duration of Cathode Grace. Casting is on a cooldown.
abilities.zhDescription: 在短时内可获取提升的暴击几率和能量恢复，每击杀一名敌人都可以延长「阴极泰来」的持续时间。施放后进入技能冷却时间。

abilities.description: Gyre’s mechanisms spin at incredible speeds, generating an Electric Field that shocks nearby enemies. When Gyre gets a critical hit, a large electrical discharge will chain from the enemy that was hit to nearby enemies.
abilities.zhDescription: Gyre 的机械装置会以令人难以置信的速度高速旋转产生一个电场，并电击附近的敌人。当 Gyre 造成暴击后，被击中的敌人处会产生一个巨大的电流来攻击附近的敌人。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Gyre/Gyre.name: Gyre
/Lotus/Powersuits/Gyre/Gyre.description: Annihilate enemies with the conductivity of coils and transmitters. Gyre’s electric attacks provide crowd control. She is the embodiment of elegant theory.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Gyre/Gyre.zhDescription: 通过带电线圈与发射器的传导性来消灭敌人，Gyre 的电击可对敌人施加群体控制。她是优雅理论的化身。

abilities.description: Launch a Gyratory Sphere that will deal high damage on impact and periodically deal electrical shocks to nearby enemies. Hit multiple enemies at once with the initial launch to enhance damage.
abilities.zhDescription: 发射一颗回旋球体，在撞击时造成大量伤害，并且可以定期对周围的敌人产生电击。在初始发射时一次性击中多名敌人来提升伤害。

abilities.description: Throw forward a Gyratory Sphere that will implode after a few seconds or can be manually triggered.
abilities.zhDescription: 扔出一颗会在几秒后向内爆炸的回旋球体，或是手动触发。

abilities.description: Gain a brief burst of increased Critical Chance and Energy Regen, with each kill extending duration of Cathode Grace. Casting is on a cooldown.
abilities.zhDescription: 在短时内可获取提升的暴击几率和能量恢复，每击杀一名敌人都可以延长「阴极泰来」的持续时间。施放后进入技能冷却时间。

abilities.description: Gyre’s mechanisms spin at incredible speeds, generating an Electric Field that shocks nearby enemies. When Gyre gets a critical hit, a large electrical discharge will chain from the enemy that was hit to nearby enemies.
abilities.zhDescription: Gyre 的机械装置会以令人难以置信的速度高速旋转产生一个电场，并电击附近的敌人。当 Gyre 造成暴击后，被击中的敌人处会产生一个巨大的电流来攻击附近的敌人。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Glass/Glass.name: Gara
/Lotus/Powersuits/Glass/Glass.description: Enemies are made fragile by Gara’s deadly touch. Gara’s vitric abilities provide her and her allies with survivability and deal high damage. Shatter the foe.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Glass/Glass.zhDescription: Gara 以致命之触让敌人变成易碎之物。Gara 的玻璃技能为她和她的友军提供了生存能力，同时能造成高伤害。粉碎敌人。

abilities.description: Lash out with stream of shattered glass, or hold for an arcing strike. Stats are boosted by the equipped mods on Shattered Lash.
abilities.zhDescription: 使用一束玻璃碎片向前方猛击，按住技能键则可改变攻击轨迹，依弧线挥出玻璃束。装备在「琉璃碎击」的 Mod 可以增强技能威力。

abilities.description: Gara's armor splinters into a maelstrom of shattered glass. Allies who contact the cloud are fortified against damage.
abilities.zhDescription: Gara 的护甲会分裂为碎玻璃组成的漩涡。置身其中的友军可减免敌人的伤害。

abilities.description: Trap enemies in a carousel of mirrors, forcing them to attack visions of their true selves. Destroyed mirrors damage their attackers, as does the collapse of the carousel.
abilities.zhDescription: 制造一圈旋转的镜面吸引敌人，迫使他们攻击自己的镜像。镜面遭到破坏时将会伤害攻击者；当复数镜面瓦解时将对范围内所有敌人造成伤害。

abilities.description: Create an expanding ring of molten glass that slowly crystallizes enemies who enter. When the expansion is complete, the ring hardens to block weapons fire. The ring draws extra strength from the health and shields of crystallized enemies. Use Shattered Lash to smash the ring and send razor-sharp glass flying.
abilities.zhDescription: 创造一圈逐渐扩张的熔融玻璃环，进入环内的敌人将逐渐结晶化。当扩张完毕时，玻璃环将硬化并能阻挡外界火力。环可以从结晶化敌人的护盾和生命中获取额外的力量。使用「琉璃碎击」可以击碎玻璃环，并将尖锐的玻璃碎片击飞。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Glass/GaraPrime.name: Gara Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Glass/GaraPrime.description: Continue the legend of the glass-armored warrior Gara. Dominate the battlefield with the power and purity of crystal.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Glass/GaraPrime.zhDescription: 身披玻璃铠甲，继承传奇战士 Gara 的遗志。用水晶的纯净力量统治战场。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Geode/Geode.name: Citrine
/Lotus/Powersuits/Geode/Geode.description: Gaze upon the Crystal Bastion. Citrine's crystalline might supports allies on the battlefield. Combat only enhances her fractal beauty.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Geode/Geode.zhDescription: 凝视这位水晶卫士。Citrine 的水晶可以在战场上支持盟友。战斗只会增强她的分形之美。

abilities.description: Slash and stagger enemies with a crystal blast that inflicts <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status. Enemies afflicted with this Status Effect have an increased chance of dropping Health and Energy Orbs.
abilities.zhDescription: 用造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态的水晶爆裂切割敌人并使敌人失衡。在此异常状态下的敌人有更高的几率掉落生命球和能量球。

abilities.description: Citrine guards herself and nearby allies with a crystalline shell that gradually decays. Kills and assists increase the defensive power of the shell.
abilities.zhDescription: Citrine 通过逐渐衰减的水晶外壳保护自己和附近的盟友。击杀和助攻可以增加外壳的防御能力。

abilities.description: Deploy a gem that shoots prismatic beams. The gem targets enemies that are taking weapon damage from Citrine and her allies. Its beams inflict Heat, Cold, Toxin, and Electricity Status Effects. Status Chance and Status Duration increase for nearby allies.
abilities.zhDescription: 放置一颗发射棱彩光束的宝石。宝石瞄准正受到 Citrine 和其队友武器伤害的敌人。其光束造成火焰、冰冻、毒素和电击异常状态。附近队友的触发几率和触发时间增加。

abilities.description: Citrine summons crystal fractals. The fractals rush forward, seeking enemies. Enemies touched by the fractals are paralyzed by crystalline growths. Hit the growths to deal Critical Damage.
abilities.zhDescription: Citrine 召唤水晶分形。分形向前冲，寻找敌人。被分形触碰的敌人会因水晶生长而瘫痪。击中水晶生长以造成暴击伤害。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Geode/CitrinePrime.name: Citrine Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Geode/CitrinePrime.description: The crystalline citadel ascends. Citrine Prime captivates with refined radiance, her brilliant gems set within the finest gold filigree.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Geode/CitrinePrime.zhDescription: 水晶堡垒拔地而起。Citrine Prime 散发着令人着迷的夺目光彩，她那璀璨的宝石镶嵌在精美的金丝花纹中。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Garuda/GarudaPrime.name: Garuda Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Garuda/GarudaPrime.description: White, gold and deepest scarlet, the queen of gore in full regalia.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Garuda/GarudaPrime.zhDescription: 纯白、耀金与至深猩红，血腥女王盛装登场。

abilities.description: Rip the life force from an enemy and use it as a shield that captures damage, this kills significantly weakened enemies instantly. Charge to channel the captured damage into an explosive projectile.
abilities.zhDescription: 从敌人身上割取生命之力以作为抵挡伤害的盾。蓄力可使抵挡的伤害化为爆裂破片。

abilities.description: Impale an enemy on an altar of talons and siphon health for Garuda and her allies.
abilities.zhDescription: 以利爪构筑的祭坛刺穿敌人，为自己及队友吸取生命。

abilities.description: Garuda sacrifices her health to generate energy and clear Status Effects.
abilities.zhDescription: Garuda 以她的生命值为代价换取能量并清除异常状态。

abilities.description: Charge to expand the targeting area, release to send Garuda's talons careening toward each target in area. Surviving enemies are prone to <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.
abilities.zhDescription: 蓄力可扩大瞄准区域，接着对瞄准区域里的每一名敌人发射高速利爪；幸存的敌人极有可能受 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态影响。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Garuda/Garuda.name: Garuda
/Lotus/Powersuits/Garuda/Garuda.description: Death’s crimson maiden sharpens her talons. Garuda weaponizes the blood of her foes to deal high damage. Sanguine beauty complements her deadly power.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Garuda/Garuda.zhDescription: 血之女王磨砺着她的利爪。Garuda 以敌人的血液为武器，造成高额伤害。血色的美丽与她致命的力量相得益彰。
