/Lotus/Powersuits/Frumentarius/Frumentar.name: Cyte-09
/Lotus/Powersuits/Frumentarius/Frumentar.description: Move like a shadow, strike with force. The Orokin created a Warframe that marries damage and stealth to eliminate sensitive problems, but he disappeared in the chaos of their demise. All that remains is a batch name: Cyte-09.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Frumentarius/Frumentar.zhDescription: 身随影动，强势出击。奥罗金创造了一款结合了伤害和隐身的战甲用于解决掉一些敏感问题，但他在奥罗金灭亡的混乱之中消失了。只剩下一个批次名称：Cyte-09。

abilities.description: Plant an antenna that projects a forward wave scan. Detected enemies take increased Weak Point Damage, and become visible through walls. Weapons gain Punch through.
abilities.zhDescription: 放置一根天线向前发射扫描波。被探测到的敌人会受到更高的弱点伤害，并可透过墙壁被看到。武器获得穿透。

abilities.description:
Throw two Elemental Ammo Packs that instantly refill the active weapon's magazine, while granting the weapon an additional instance of the selected Elemental Damage and Status Effect. Reload clears the effect. Sniper Rifles gain extra damage.

Hold the ability to select the Elemental Damage type.
abilities.zhDescription:
投掷两个元素弹药包，可立即为当前的武器填满弹匣，同时为武器附加所选的元素伤害和异常状态。重新装填会清除效果。狙击枪可获得额外伤害。

长按技能键以选择元素伤害类型。

abilities.description: Jump backwards and become invisible for a short duration. Killing enemies on their Weak Points extends the duration and heals Cyte-09.
abilities.zhDescription: 向后跳跃并短暂隐形。弱点击杀可延长持续时间并治疗 Cyte-09。

abilities.description: Summon the Neutralizer, Cyte-09’s exalted Sniper Rifle. Bullets ricochet off Weak Points to seek out other nearby Weak Points. Alt fire lobs a <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold grenade that completely freezes enemies.
abilities.zhDescription: 召唤肃清者，Cyte-09 的显赫狙击步枪。命中弱点的子弹会弹射追踪附近的其它弱点。次要射击发射 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻榴弹，完全冻结敌人。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Frost/FrostPrime.name: Frost Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Frost/FrostPrime.description: Frost Prime has the same chilling abilities as Frost but provides unique mod polarities, allowing for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Frost/FrostPrime.zhDescription: Frost Prime 拥有与 Frost 一样的急冻技能，但自带独特的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

abilities.description: A frigid energy blast that freezes targets in their tracks.
abilities.zhDescription: 发射一道极度低温的能量来冻结目标。

abilities.description: Sends a wave of razor sharp, crystalized ice toward an enemy, dealing heavy damage.
abilities.zhDescription: 制造一道由锋利冰晶构成的冰浪来对敌人造成大量伤害及缓速效果。

abilities.description: Frost deep freezes any vapor and moisture in the area, creating a protective sphere with brief invulnerability to boost its strength.
abilities.zhDescription: 冻结周围所有水气与水分，制造出能用来防御的球形冰罩；冰罩生成时有短暂的无敌时间，此时敌人对冰罩造成的伤害能强化冰罩的耐久度；在相同位置重复施放冰罩可强化其耐久度。

abilities.description: Summons a treacherous landslide of ice that instantly freezes and shatters all enemies in its radius.
abilities.zhDescription: 唤来变化莫测的雪崩，瞬间冻结并粉碎范围内的所有敌人。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Frost/Frost.name: Frost
/Lotus/Powersuits/Frost/Frost.description: When Frost steps onto the battlefield, enemies experience a chill. Frost's attacks control crowds, protect objectives, and increase survivability. Wield the biting cold.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Frost/Frost.zhDescription: 当 Frost 踏上战场时，敌人会感到一阵寒意。 Frost 的攻击可以提供群体控制、保护目标，并提高生存力。驾驭刺骨的冰雪之力。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Fairy/TitaniaPrime.name: Titania Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Fairy/TitaniaPrime.description: Tempting and terrifying, this is Titania in her ultimate form.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Fairy/TitaniaPrime.zhDescription: 诱人而又令人恐惧，这就是 Titania 的终极形态。

abilities.description: Enemies fumble their weapons as they are whisked into the air. Nearby allies become immune to Status Effects. Hold the ability to cast the immunity onto Titania.
abilities.zhDescription: 把敌人扫到空中，使其丢掉武器；让附近的友军对异常状态免疫。长按此技能来使 Titania 获得免疫效果。

abilities.description: Cycle through and extract one of the four Buffs when cast on an enemy. Thorns reduces incoming damage. Dust degrades enemy accuracy. Full Moon increases companion damage. Entangle slows enemies within range.
abilities.zhDescription: 当对一名敌人施放技能时，循环切换并从四种增益效果中选取出一种。「荆棘」减免来袭的伤害。「尘埃」降低敌人的精准度。「满月」增加同伴的伤害。「纠缠」使范围内的敌人减速。

abilities.description: Create a swarm of razorflies that transform an enemy into an irresistible floating beacon, attracting witless comrades before exploding on command.
abilities.zhDescription: 制造一群剃刀蝶将敌人转换为一个具有强力吸引力的漂浮信标，在爆炸以前吸引那些不明事理的战友靠近。

abilities.description: Shrink down and take flight, while razorflies attack nearby enemies and amplify the damage they take.
abilities.zhDescription: 缩小身体并进入飞行状态，同时剃刀蝶会攻击附近的敌人并放大他们所受到的伤害。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Fairy/Fairy.name: Titania
/Lotus/Powersuits/Fairy/Fairy.description: Titania’s fairy-like appearance belies her formidable regal power. The enchantress deals high damage and provides crowd control. She forces opponents to pay homage or perish.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Fairy/Fairy.zhDescription: Titania 仙女般的外表掩盖了她强大的统治力量。这个女魔法师可造成高额伤害并对敌人实施群体控制。她会迫使对手向她致敬，否则就会灭亡。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Excalibur/ExcaliburUmb.name: Excalibur Umbra
/Lotus/Powersuits/Excalibur/ExcaliburUmb.description: From the shadow of the long night emerges a new Excalibur.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Excalibur/ExcaliburUmb.zhDescription: 来自长夜暗影中的新型 Excalibur。

abilities.description: Slash and dash through enemies alongside a radial specter. The powerful Exalted Blade’s slashes inflict <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.
abilities.zhDescription: 随着残影对敌人进行冲刺斩击。强大的显赫刀剑斩击造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。

abilities.description: Let out ferocious howl that stuns nearby enemies and causes Sentients to shed any built up resistances.
abilities.zhDescription: 用凶猛的嚎声震慑附近的敌人，并消除 Sentient 敌人所积累的全部抗性。

abilities.description: Radial javelins impale nearby enemies, inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.
abilities.zhDescription: 发射广域标枪刺穿附近的敌人，造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Excalibur/ExcaliburPri.name: Excalibur Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Excalibur/ExcaliburPri.description: Excalibur Prime is the epitome of mobility and offense, and features the same abilities as Excalibur, but has unique mod polarities installed allowing for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Excalibur/ExcaliburPri.zhDescription: Excalibur Prime 是机动性与攻击性的象征，并拥有与 Excalibur 一样的技能，但自带独特的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

abilities.description: Emit a bright flash of light, blinding all nearby enemies.
abilities.zhDescription: 释放一道明亮的闪光，致盲附近所有的敌人。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Excalibur/Excalibur.description: Excalibur epitomizes the warrior spirit. His master swordsmanship deals high damage. He is the embodiment of martial excellence.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Excalibur/Excalibur.zhDescription: Excalibur 是战士精神的缩影。他炉火纯青的剑术可造成高额伤害。他是卓越武学的化身。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Ember/EmberPrime.name: Ember Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ember/EmberPrime.description: Ember Prime offers the same potential for wanton destruction as Ember but provides unique mod polarities, allowing for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ember/EmberPrime.zhDescription: Ember Prime 具有像 Ember 一样肆意破坏的潜力，但自带独特的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

abilities.description: Release a fiery projectile that ignites enemies on contact.
abilities.zhDescription: 释放一个燃烧的投射物，点燃接触到的目标。

abilities.description: Protect Ember with flame armor that burns stronger over time, consuming energy once its meter is at full strength. Cast again to extinguish the flame.
abilities.zhDescription: 通过火焰装甲来保护 Ember，随时间的推移保护效果会增强。计量表达到最大度数后会消耗能量。重新施放技能可以熄灭火焰。

abilities.description: Slam the ground to create a wave of incinerating plasma that knocks back enemies and strips their armor.
abilities.zhDescription: 猛击地面以产生一道焚化的等离子波来将敌人击退并剥去他们的护甲。

abilities.description: Command a flaming comet to crash down in front of Ember, engulfing enemies with a fire that can spread through their ranks.
abilities.zhDescription: 召唤一颗燃烧的彗星坠落在 Ember 的前面，让扩散的火焰来吞没敌人。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Ember/Ember.name: Ember
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ember/Ember.description: Harness the power of fire. Ember’s heat deals high damage. She keeps a cool head when the battle is hot.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Ember/Ember.zhDescription: 操纵烈焰之力。Ember 的火焰会造成很高的伤害。即使战斗进入白热化时，她仍能保持冷静的头脑。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Duelist/Duelist.name: Narin
/Lotus/Powersuits/Duelist/Duelist.description: Narin descends in swirling eddies, her blade keen and deadly as an icy wind. She wields ice to defend as deftly as her swift rapier strikes.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Duelist/Duelist.zhDescription: Narin 如旋涡般降临，她的利刃锋利无比，如同凛冽的寒风。她能巧妙地运用冰霜防御，如同她迅捷的细剑攻击一般。

abilities.description:
Lunge with Narin's ice rapier Neote, inflicting <DT_FREEZE_COLOR> Cold Damage and <DT_FREEZE_COLOR> Cold and <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR> Puncture Status Effect on foes directly ahead of her.

Gain Ice for each enemy hit.
abilities.zhDescription:
挥舞 Narin 的细剑寒霜疾剑进行突刺，对正前方敌人造成 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害以及 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻和 <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>穿刺异常状态。

每击中一个敌人可获得冰能量。

abilities.description:
Recover Shields by absorbing <DT_FREEZE_COLOR> Cold Status Effect from nearby enemies. Gain <OVERGUARD_GAIN> Overguard if at full Shields.

Gain Ice for each enemy hit.
abilities.zhDescription:
通过吸收附近敌人施加的 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻异常状态来恢复护盾。如果护盾已满，则获得 <OVERGUARD_GAIN>超宏防护。

每击中一个敌人可获得冰能量。

abilities.description:
Tap to leap into the air, tap again to land at target location. Applies <DT_FREEZE_COLOR> Cold Damage Vulnerability and Status Effect in a large radius upon landing.

Gain Ice for each enemy hit.
abilities.zhDescription:
轻按可跃向空中，再次轻按即可落在目标位置。落地时，对大范围内的敌人施加 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害易伤和异常状态效果。

每击中一个敌人可获得冰能量。

abilities.description: Requires full Ice to cast. An ancestral spirit descends upon Narin and she begins sword dancing for continuous nearby damage. Press Attack to launch shattering icy slashes that deplete Armor and Shields. Hitting Frozen enemies causes them to explode, dealing massive radial <DT_FREEZE_COLOR> Cold Damage. Attacks on Marked Targets cost no Ice and do more damage.
abilities.zhDescription: 需要满冰能量才能施放。先祖之灵降临在 Narin 身上，她随即开始剑舞，对周围敌人造成持续伤害。按下攻击键即可发射粉碎性的冰刃斩击，削弱其护甲和护盾。击中被冻结的敌人会使其爆炸，造成大范围 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害。攻击被标记的目标不消耗冰能量，并造成更高伤害。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Dragon/Dragon.name: Chroma
/Lotus/Powersuits/Dragon/Dragon.description: Unleash the draconic. Chroma employs Heat, Electricity, Toxin, and Cold to deal high damage while maintaining survivability. Soar with winged fury.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Dragon/Dragon.zhDescription: 释放龙之力量。Chroma 使用火焰、电击、毒素和冰冻元素来造成高伤害，同时保持生存能力。以愤怒为翼，翱翔吧。

abilities.description: Exhale a deep breath of elemental destruction. Tap to cycle through elements, hold to cast. The chosen element applies to all of Chroma's abilities.
abilities.zhDescription: 释放一股毁灭性的元素吐息。轻点技能键来在各个元素之间进行切换，按住技能键来施放技能。选中的元素会应用于 Chroma 所有的技能。

abilities.description: Depending on Chroma's elemental alignment, an offensive area-of-effect is created. Chroma and its nearby allies are imbued with defensive energy.
abilities.zhDescription: 根据 Chroma 的元素属性，制造攻击性的范围效果。而 Chroma 和附近的盟友会被这股防御能量保护。

abilities.description: Chroma fortifies squad Armor when his Shields are damaged or he kills an enemy with a melee weapon. He increases squad Weapon Damage when he loses Health or he kills an enemy with a ranged weapon, double the effect on weak point kills.
abilities.zhDescription: Chroma 的护盾受损或使用近战武器击杀敌人时会强化小队的护甲。当他损失生命值或使用远程武器杀死敌人时，会增加小队的武器伤害，以弱点击杀则效果加倍。

abilities.description: Chroma turns his pelt into a massive sentry that strengthens nearby allies and engulfs enemies in elemental attacks.
abilities.zhDescription: Chroma 把他的皮甲转换成一个巨大的警戒护卫，它可以增强附近的盟友并且用元素属性攻击吞噬敌人。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Dragon/ChromaPrime.name: Chroma Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Dragon/ChromaPrime.description: Bind the elements and unleash untold destruction with Chroma Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Dragon/ChromaPrime.zhDescription: 与元素紧密结合并发动无尽毁灭之力的 Chroma Prime。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

abilities.zhDescription: Chroma 把他的皮甲转换成一个巨大的警戒护卫，它可以增强附近的盟友并且用元素属性攻击吞噬敌人。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Devourer/GrendelPrime.name: Grendel Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Devourer/GrendelPrime.description: Primal. Insatiable. Grendel Prime devours all who oppose him.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Devourer/GrendelPrime.zhDescription: 原始。永不饱足。Grendel Prime 吞食所有反抗他的人。

abilities.description: Swallow enemies whole and store them in Grendel's gut. Hold to vomit out stored enemies, covering them in toxic bile.
abilities.zhDescription: 将敌人囫囵吞入 Grendel 的腹内。按住技能键即可将腹内的敌人吐出，而这些敌人身上会覆盖着毒性消化液。

abilities.description: Regenerate health as Grendel absorbs nourishment from enemies in his gut. While he digests, enemies that attack or are attacked by Grendel suffer <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage and energy sources provide more energy. These buffs extend to squad mates.
abilities.zhDescription: Grendel 从他腹内的敌人摄取营养并恢复生命值。当他消化时，攻击 Grendel 或被 Grendel 攻击的敌人遭受<DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害，并且能量源提供更多的能量。小队队员也会获得这些增益。

abilities.description: Grendel curls into a ball. He heals over time as he rolls, knocking over anyone in his path. Jumping slams Grendel into the ground and generates a damaging shockwave.
abilities.zhDescription: Grendel 蜷缩成一个球，在此期间他会随时间流逝恢复生命值，并冲撞任何胆敢挡住他的人。跳跃会让 Grendel 朝地面猛砸，并产生一股破坏性的冲击波。

abilities.description: Violently puke out a bile soaked enemy from Grendel's gut, turning the consumed into a toxic projectile that does bonus damage based on the enemy's Max Health. Nearby enemies are slowed and have their armor dissolved by the bile.
abilities.zhDescription: 将浸泡在 Grendel 体内消化液里的一个敌人猛烈吐出，让这个被吞噬的生物成为一团毒素投射物，并基于敌人的最大生命值造成额外伤害。其消化液会使附近的敌人减速，并且会溶解他们的护甲。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Devourer/Devourer.name: Grendel
/Lotus/Powersuits/Devourer/Devourer.description: Grendel sees every battlefield as a smorgasbord. His insatiable appetite rewards him with high survivability. Enemies will be eaten. And regurgitated.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Devourer/Devourer.zhDescription: Grendel 将每个战场都视为大杂烩。他贪得无厌的胃口使他具有很高的生存能力。敌人会被吃掉，然后被吐出。

/Lotus/Powersuits/DemonFrame/DemonFrame.name: Uriel
/Lotus/Powersuits/DemonFrame/DemonFrame.description: To fight as the Heretic of Xata is to have demons at your back. Uriel incinerates foes with searing brimstone, and commands three fiendish summons to do his devil’s work.
/Lotus/Powersuits/DemonFrame/DemonFrame.zhDescription: 以 Xata 异端者的身份战斗，意味着背后有恶魔相助。Uriel 用灼热的硫磺焚烧敌人，并召唤三个邪恶仆从为他效力。

abilities.description:
Manifest an aura of flames inflicting <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage and Status Effect on nearby enemies.

Tap Dodge while airborne to take flight as a flaming meteor of destruction.
abilities.zhDescription:
释放火焰光环，对附近敌人造成 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害和异常状态。

在空中按下闪避即可化身为毁灭性的火焰流星飞行。

abilities.description: Uriel heals himself and his demons. If his demons are dead, they are resurrected.
abilities.zhDescription: Uriel 治愈自己和他的恶魔。如果他的恶魔死去，他们将被复活。

abilities.description: Uriel rips out the souls of his demons, draining their health, and sends them in search of new victims. Souls explode on contact with an enemy, rendering it vulnerable to Damage.
abilities.zhDescription: Uriel 取出他恶魔的灵魂，吸取他们的生命，然后驱使他们去寻找新的受害者。这些灵魂在接触敌人时会爆炸，使敌人容易受到伤害。

abilities.description: Uriel and his demons create a growing ring of flaming brimstone. Charge the ability by utilizing demon abilities. Damage inflicted increases with each consecutive hit.
abilities.zhDescription: Uriel 和他的恶魔们创造出一个不断扩大的炽热硫磺圈。使用恶魔技能可以为此技能充能。每次连续命中都会增加造成的伤害。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Dagath/Dagath.name: Dagath
/Lotus/Powersuits/Dagath/Dagath.description: Never underestimate the power and wrath of sullen sadness. Dagath's malice deals high damage.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Dagath/Dagath.zhDescription: 永远不要低估忧怨带来的力量和怒火。Dagath 的怨恨会造成很高的伤害。

abilities.description: Wyrd Scythes surround Dagath and seek out nearby enemies. Those struck are slowed and suffer <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect. The scythes also spread Doom and extend its duration.
abilities.zhDescription: 命定镰刃包围 Dagath 并寻找附近的敌人。被击中的敌人会被减速并受到 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害且必定触发异常状态。镰刃还会传播厄运并延长其持续时间。

abilities.description: Condemn nearby enemies to their doom. A portion of the damage Dagath deals is revisited upon them by a Wyrd Scythe. They also suffer <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage.
abilities.zhDescription: 用厄运诅咒附近的敌人。Dagath 对敌人造成的部分伤害会通过命定镰刃再次施加。敌人还会受到 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害。

abilities.description: Supercharge Dagath's weapons with extra Critical Damage. The effects are doubled on Doomed enemies. Escape fatal blows by briefly assuming a spectral form.
abilities.zhDescription: 为 Dagath 的武器提供额外的暴击伤害。对被厄运诅咒的敌人效果加倍。遭受致命攻击时短暂地进入幽灵形态并逃脱。

abilities.description: Phantom Kaithes charge forth, inflicting <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage upon all in their path. Their attack strips the defenses of Doomed enemies.
abilities.zhDescription: 召唤绝灵骥幻影向前冲锋，对其冲锋路径上的所有人造成 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害。同时削弱被厄运诅咒敌人的防御。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Cowgirl/MesaPrime.name: Mesa Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Cowgirl/MesaPrime.description: Cast a long shadow with this lethal enforcer. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Cowgirl/MesaPrime.zhDescription: 通过这名致命的执法者投射一道长影。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

abilities.description: When activated, this power stores damage caused by guns. When triggered again, that damage is channelled through the next gunshot.
abilities.zhDescription: 启动时，这个技能会储存枪支造成的伤害。当再次启动，储存的伤害会导引至下一次射击。

abilities.description: Gives an ally Extra Damage while jamming the guns of nearby enemies. This power shifts between team members.
abilities.zhDescription: 为队友增加额外伤害，同时干扰附近敌人的枪支运作。这个能力会在队伍成员之间转移。

abilities.description: Envelops Mesa in a barrier of energy, reflecting back incoming bullet damage.
abilities.zhDescription: Mesa 笼罩在能量障壁之中，反射来袭的子弹伤害。

abilities.description: With intense focus, Mesa draws her Regulator pistols, shooting down her foes in rapid succession.
abilities.zhDescription: 在极度的专注之下，Mesa 以她的监察者双枪，对敌人快速地连续射击。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Cowgirl/Cowgirl.name: Mesa
/Lotus/Powersuits/Cowgirl/Cowgirl.description: The gunslinger has a steady deadly hand. Each shot deals high damage. Mesa is the fastest draw in the realm.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Cowgirl/Cowgirl.zhDescription: 枪手往往有一双稳定的死神之手。她每次射击都会造成高额伤害。Mesa 是该领域最快的拔枪手。

abilities.description: When activated, this power stores damage caused by guns. When triggered again, that damage is channelled through the next gunshot.
abilities.zhDescription: 启动时，这个技能会储存枪支造成的伤害。当再次启动，储存的伤害会导引至下一次射击。

abilities.description: Gives an ally Extra Damage while jamming the guns of nearby enemies. This power shifts between team members.
abilities.zhDescription: 为队友增加额外伤害，同时干扰附近敌人的枪支运作。这个能力会在队伍成员之间转移。

abilities.description: Envelops Mesa in a barrier of energy, reflecting back incoming bullet damage.
abilities.zhDescription: Mesa 笼罩在能量障壁之中，反射来袭的子弹伤害。

abilities.description: With intense focus, Mesa draws her Regulator pistols, shooting down her foes in rapid succession.
abilities.zhDescription: 在极度的专注之下，Mesa 以她的监察者双枪，对敌人快速地连续射击。

/Lotus/Powersuits/ConcreteFrame/Concrete.name: Qorvex
/Lotus/Powersuits/ConcreteFrame/Concrete.description: Albrecht Entrati designed Qorvex to protect a Chosen Operator from the unique hazards of his lab. A Crucible Core gives Qorvex high survivability as he provides crowd control.
/Lotus/Powersuits/ConcreteFrame/Concrete.zhDescription: 阿尔布雷希特·英择谛设计 Qorvex，是为了防止被选中的指挥官受到其实验室中特殊风险的危害。堆芯赋予了 Qorvex 群体控制的能力，从而使其具有强大的生存能力。

abilities.description: Summon a Chyrinka Pillar that slows enemies. It pulses <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect.
abilities.zhDescription: 召唤出一根辐射柱体来减速敌人。它会造成 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射伤害且必定触发异常状态。

abilities.description: Contain the threat. Qorvex summons walls that slam together, damaging all enemies caught between them and inflicting <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status.
abilities.zhDescription: 遏制威胁。Qorvex 召唤出墙壁并使其猛烈撞击在一起，对夹在其中的所有敌人造成伤害并造成 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射异常状态。

abilities.description: Guard yourself and nearby allies against Status Effects. Each time Qorvex kills or assists in killing an enemy affected by <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status, the number of Status Effects Disometric Guard can prevent increases.
abilities.zhDescription: 保护自己和附近的友军免受异常状态影响。Qorvex 每次击杀或协助击杀受到 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射状态影响的敌人时，辐量防护可以阻止的异常状态数量会增加。

abilities.description: Release a beam from Qorvex's Crucible Core. Each enemy struck suffers <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect. Enemies affected by <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status explode in a chain reaction.
abilities.zhDescription: 从 Qorvex 的堆芯中释放光束。对命中的所有敌人造成 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射伤害，且必定触发异常状态。命中受到 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射异常状态影响的敌人会引发链式反应爆炸。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Choir/Choir.name: Jade
/Lotus/Powersuits/Choir/Choir.description: Become enraptured by the song of devastation. Through her, the Jade Light can be a force of destruction or a source of support.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Choir/Choir.zhDescription: 沉醉于毁灭之歌。通过她，翠玉之光可以成为毁灭之力，也可以成为支持之源。

abilities.description: Create a well of light that heals allies and hurts enemies. Those who enter the well will be highlighted by Judgments.
abilities.zhDescription: 创造一口圣光之井治愈友军并对敌人造成伤害。进入井中的敌人将被"审判"标记。

abilities.description: Cycle through three songs that strengthen allies. Power of The Seven increases Ability Strength. Deathbringer increases Weapon Damage. Spirit of Resilience increases Shield Effectiveness. Extend the duration of each song by killing enemies surrounded by Judgments.
abilities.zhDescription: 循环奏响三首颂歌增强友军。《七人众之力》增加技能强度。《死亡使者》增加武器伤害。《坚韧之灵》增加护盾效率。击杀被审判的敌人可以延长颂歌的持续时间。

abilities.description: Jade summons an accusatory gaze that slows nearby enemies and dissolves their Shields and Armor. When the gaze falls upon allies, they can be revived from a distance.
abilities.zhDescription: Jade 召唤谴责之瞳使附近的敌人减速并分解他们的护盾和护甲。当谴责之瞳凝视友军时，可以将其远距离复活。

abilities.description: Soar with destructive power. Use alternate-fire to detonate Judgments, causing an explosion of Jade Light. Enemies inside the Light's Judgment radius empower the explosion.
abilities.zhDescription: 以毁灭性的力量翱翔天际。使用次要射击引爆审判，造成翠玉之光爆炸。处于圣光审判影响范围内的敌人会增强爆炸效果。

/Lotus/Powersuits/BrokenFrame/XakuPrime.name: Xaku Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/BrokenFrame/XakuPrime.description: The child of war and void is reborn in gold. That which was once shattered may rise stronger than that which was never broken.
/Lotus/Powersuits/BrokenFrame/XakuPrime.zhDescription: 战争与虚空之子在黄金中重生。曾经破碎过的东西可能会比从未破碎过的东西更强大。

abilities.description: Wield <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>Void Damage for all attacks from equipped weapons when activated.
abilities.zhDescription: 技能激活期间，所有装备的武器都会造成 <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>虚空伤害。

abilities.description: Void Tendrils steal weapons from nearby enemies to use as your own floating, auto-targeting armament. Damage output increases based on enemy level. The number of weapons grabbed also determines the damage multiplier for The Lost: Deny's Void beam.
abilities.zhDescription: 虚空卷须偷取附近敌人的武器，以作为自己的浮空自瞄武器来使用。伤害输出会根据敌人等级增加。抢到的武器数量也决定了「失落之技：否认」的虚空射线的伤害倍数。

abilities.description: Cycle through a trio of lost Warframe powers. Accuse manifests a Void fissure to corrupt enemies into allies. Gaze grasps targets in Void tendrils that capture damage and inflict it when the target is released. Deny annihilates with a beam of Void energy, wiping Sentient resistances.
abilities.zhDescription: 循环切换三种失落之技。「指责」幻化出虚空裂缝，来让敌人堕落成为友军。「凝视」通过虚空卷须抓住目标，并在目标被释放时，捕捉伤害并对目标造成伤害。「否认」通过一束虚空能量来进行湮灭攻击，并消除 Sentient 抗性。

abilities.description: Temporarily shed the outer pieces of Xaku in a destructive blast, then stalk the battlefield in a new, swifter skeletal form. Enemies damaged by the body shrapnel are rendered weaker to <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>Void Damage. Xaku's other active abilities' duration is frozen in time and resumes once The Vast Untime expires.
abilities.zhDescription: Xaku 的外层结构在毁灭性的爆炸中暂时舍弃，然后以全新的的骨骼形态疾步潜行于战场。受到 Xaku 身体碎片击中的敌人会更难抵御 <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>虚空伤害。在超维炼狱施放期间，Xaku 其他主动技能的持续时间将会冻结，技能终止时恢复。

/Lotus/Powersuits/BrokenFrame/BrokenFram.name: Xaku
/Lotus/Powersuits/BrokenFrame/BrokenFram.description: Broken Warframes adrift in the Void converged to create Xaku. Together, they deal high damage. Xaku proves that the sum of the whole is greater than its parts.
/Lotus/Powersuits/BrokenFrame/BrokenFram.zhDescription: 漂浮在虚空中的破碎战甲汇聚在一起，形成了 Xaku。他们齐心协力，造成高额的伤害。Xaku 证明了合力的力量胜过单独的力量。

abilities.zhDescription: 技能激活期间，所有装备的武器都会造成 <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>虚空伤害。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Brawler/Brawler.name: Atlas
/Lotus/Powersuits/Brawler/Brawler.description: Enemies tremble before the brawler with fists as hard as stone. Atlas deals high damage. Command terrestrial elements that form the foundation of any battlefield.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Brawler/Brawler.zhDescription: 在这个拳头坚硬如石头的搏击者面前，敌人瑟瑟发抖。Atlas 可以造成高额的伤害。掌控构筑战场基石的大地之力。

abilities.description: Bash enemies with an explosive sliding punch, repeat up to three times for a combo attack. Each hit in the three-punch combo increases the radius of the attack. Energy cost is reduced with each hit of Landslide. Install mods on the Landslide Fists to boost stats.
abilities.zhDescription: 用爆炸性的滑行冲拳猛击敌人，最多重复三次，形成连击。三拳连击中的每一后续攻击都会增加攻击范围。土石坍方的每次命中都会减少能量消耗。可通过在土石坍方上装备 Mod 增加属性数值。

abilities.description: Summon a Bulwark rock-wall, activate again to send the rocks crashing toward the enemy. Bulwarks attacked by enemies release an area-of-effect Slash powered by the Health it has lost.
abilities.zhDescription: 召唤一堵「大地堡垒」石墙，再次启用技能可使巨石滚动压倒前方的敌人。被敌人攻击的石墙会释放一个区域性的切割伤害，由其失去的生命值来维持。

abilities.description: Atlas' hardened gaze will fossilize foes increasing the damage they take, heal Rumblers, and create Petrified Bulwarks. When shattered, petrified enemies drop healing Rubble for Atlas.
abilities.zhDescription: Atlas 强硬的凝视将石化敌人并增加他们受到的伤害、治疗石头人，并创造出石化壁垒。当石化的敌人碎裂后，将掉出可以治疗 Atlas 的碎石。

abilities.description: Summon two elemental stone brawlers to the melee. Summoning petrifies enemies in close proximity to Atlas. When finished, Rumblers collapse into a pile of healing Rubble.
abilities.zhDescription: 召唤两个元素石头近战打手。召唤动作将石化临近 Atlas 的敌人。当它们的生命结束时，石头人将碎成一堆用于治疗的碎石。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Brawler/AtlasPrime.name: Atlas Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Brawler/AtlasPrime.description: In bygone ages, mountains were said to house warriors. In this age, the mountain has become the warrior.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Brawler/AtlasPrime.zhDescription: 在往事如烟的时代，据说山脉是战士的容身之所。在这个时代，山脉已化身成战士。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Berserker/ValkyrPrime.name: Valkyr Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Berserker/ValkyrPrime.description: A proud fighter emerges unscarred by time or malice. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Berserker/ValkyrPrime.zhDescription: 一位经历了时间与伤痛的洗礼后依然毫发无损的高傲斗士。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

abilities.description: Valkyr hurls forth a hook and pulls herself to whatever it hits. If it hits an enemy, nearby foes are pulled in as she unleashes a coordinated Melee attack.
abilities.zhDescription: Valkyr 发射钩索，将自己拉向命中的目标点。如果钩索命中敌人，则附近的敌人也会被拉向目标点，同时 Valkyr 会发动一次连携近战攻击。

abilities.description: Valkyr lets out a rallying cry that bolsters Armor and Attack Speed for allies while in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range.
abilities.zhDescription: Valkyr 发出激励式咆哮， 为 <AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围内的友军增强护甲和攻击速度。

abilities.description: Unleash a damaging blast, slowing its victims while increasing their Melee Damage Vulnerability.
abilities.zhDescription: 释放一道破坏性的冲击波使敌人减速，并使其受到的近战伤害增加。

abilities.description: Valkyr bares her deadly claws, unleashing devastating attacks that also heal her. Valkyr becomes immune to Status Effects and her Armor bonus from Warcry is multiplied while using the claws.
abilities.zhDescription: Valkyr 露出致命的利爪，释放毁灭性攻击的同时治疗自身。Valkyr 在使用利爪时免疫异常状态，且通过咆哮获得的护甲翻倍。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Berserker/Berserker.name: Valkyr
/Lotus/Powersuits/Berserker/Berserker.description: Valkyr was modified into a highly motivated and fearsome killer. She is adept at dealing damage and surviving. Her battle cry strikes terror into all who hear it.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Berserker/Berserker.zhDescription: Valkyr 被改造成一个动机强烈且令人恐惧的杀手。她善于造成伤害和生存下去。她的战吼让所有听到它的人感到恐惧。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Bard/OctaviaPrime.name: Octavia Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Bard/OctaviaPrime.description: Strike up a symphony of destruction with the mistress of music, Octavia, in her grandest and most spectacular form. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Bard/OctaviaPrime.zhDescription: 女音乐家 Octavia，以其卓绝华美的形态，演奏毁灭的乐章。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

abilities.description: Rhythmically beats damage into nearby enemies and draws their fire. Damage inflicted on the Mallet increases its lethality.
abilities.zhDescription: 随着节奏对附近的敌人造成伤害，并吸引他们的火力。施加在槌音铮鏦上的伤害会增加其杀伤力。

abilities.description: Launches a rollerball that charms foes to follow it. Combines with the Mallet to create a roving ball of sonic destruction.
abilities.zhDescription: 发射一枚滚球，利用音乐的渲染力令敌人跟随它。与槌音铮鏦相结合便可创造出一个徘徊移动的音波破坏球。

abilities.description: Grants buffs to those who consistently perform actions in time to Octavia's music. Timed jumps offer the Vivace speed buff. Crouching on the beat grants cloaking with the Nocturne buff. Firing rhythmically bestows Opera multishot buff. Timed melee swings give the Forte damage buff.
abilities.zhDescription: 给予随着 Octavia 的音乐做出相应动作的人各类增益效果。合拍的跳跃提供轻挑快板速度加成。跟上节拍的下蹲给予夜曲的隐匿增益。有节奏地射击可获得歌剧戏曲的多重射击加成。合拍的近战攻击给以强音奏鸣曲伤害加成。

abilities.description: Draws power from the decibel level of sound in the area and uses it to amplify a damage buff for Octavia and her allies. It also doubles the damage and range of nearby Mallets.
abilities.zhDescription: 从环境的分贝水平中获取能量，用来扩大 Octavia 和友军的伤害增幅。同时将附近槌音铮鏦的伤害和范围加倍。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Bard/Bard.name: Octavia
/Lotus/Powersuits/Bard/Bard.description: Octavia turns bass, beat, and melody into a symphony of devastation. The music of her Mandachord gives her high survivability and supports allies. Her composition means the enemy’s destruction.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Bard/Bard.zhDescription: Octavia 将低音、节奏和旋律编成一首毁灭的赞歌。她的曼达和弦琴音乐让她具备高度的生存能力和支援友军的能力。她谱写的歌意味着敌人的毁灭。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Banshee/BansheePrime.name: Banshee Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Banshee/BansheePrime.description: Banshee Prime assails her foes by manipulating sonic forces to deadly effect. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Banshee/BansheePrime.zhDescription: Banshee Prime 以操控声波力量造成的致死效果攻击敌人。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

abilities.description: Banshee emits a sonic shockwave that pushes targets in range with enough force to incapacitate attackers and reduce their Armor.
abilities.zhDescription: Banshee 释放一道音波冲击波，将范围内的敌人击退，使其失去战斗力并降低他们的护甲。

abilities.description: Using acoustic location, Banshee's Sonar power finds and tracks enemies, and exposes critical weak points to everyone in your squad.
abilities.zhDescription: Banshee 的声纳技能可以利用声波进行定位，借以侦测及追踪敌人，并使队伍成员发觉敌人身上暴露出的致命弱点。

abilities.description: Using Silence surrounds Banshee in an aura that stuns enemies, limits their perception and tactical response to gunfire and Warframe attacks, and renders them unable to activate their abilities.
abilities.zhDescription: 使用静音会使 Banshee 笼罩在一层光环之中，该光环会眩晕敌人，限制其对枪声和战甲攻击的感知及战术反应，并使他们无法激活自身的技能。

abilities.description: Channeling all of her acoustic energy into the environment, Banshee uses ultrasonic reverberations to violently shake the ground in a targeted area.
abilities.zhDescription: Banshee 将她所有的声音能量传导至周遭环境，使用超声波反响剧烈撼动目标区域的地面。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Banshee/Banshee.name: Banshee
/Lotus/Powersuits/Banshee/Banshee.description: Banshee's call heralds death. She maintains crowd control and identifies enemy weak points with sonic attacks. Few can hold their position when struck by her force.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Banshee/Banshee.zhDescription: Banshee 的尖叫预示着死亡。她能够用声波攻击来维持群体控制和识别敌人的弱点。当她的力量袭来，几乎没有人能够站稳脚跟。

/Lotus/Powersuits/AntiMatter/NovaPrime.name: Nova Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/AntiMatter/NovaPrime.description: Nova Prime wreaks devastation on her enemies using volatile antimatter. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
/Lotus/Powersuits/AntiMatter/NovaPrime.zhDescription: Nova Prime 以她的反物质能量波来对敌人造成破坏。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

abilities.description: Creates antimatter particles that orbit Nova and attack nearby targets. Each active particle reduces damage to Nova's Health and Shields.
abilities.zhDescription: 创造反物质粒子环绕 Nova 四周，并自动攻击邻近目标。每个处于活动状态的粒子都会减少对 Nova 的生命值和护盾造成的伤害。

abilities.description: Launch a large particle of charged antimatter that will detonate on contact. Direct the particle by aiming, shoot it to charge it further. Deals <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>Blast Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect.
abilities.zhDescription: 发射一颗大型充能反物质粒子，触碰即引爆。通过瞄准来控制粒子方向，射击以进一步充能。造成 <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>爆炸伤害，并必定造成异常状态。

abilities.description: Creates a wormhole allowing instantaneous travel. Hold the ability to visualize placement.
abilities.zhDescription: 创造一个虫洞以实现瞬间移动。长按此技能可预览放置位置。

abilities.description: Primes all enemies in an expanding radius with volatile antimatter. Press the ability to slow down enemy movement, hold the ability to speed them up.
abilities.zhDescription: 使用不稳定的反物质对一个不断扩大的范围内的所有敌人进行填充。按下技能键可减缓敌人移动速度，长按则加快其移动速度。

/Lotus/Powersuits/AntiMatter/Anti.name: Nova
/Lotus/Powersuits/AntiMatter/Anti.description: Harness antimatter. Nova uses antiparticles to provide crowd control and amplify damage output. She obliterates enemies by destabilizing matter itself.
/Lotus/Powersuits/AntiMatter/Anti.zhDescription: 利用反物质。 Nova 使用反物质粒子来提供群体控制并放大伤害输出。她通过使物质不稳定来消灭敌人。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Alchemist/LavosPrime.name: Lavos Prime
/Lotus/Powersuits/Alchemist/LavosPrime.description: Some Warframes were Prime from the start. Others ascended. Lavos, the master of transmutation, bowed to no one as he forged his own path to valor.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Alchemist/LavosPrime.zhDescription: 当其他战甲还在逐步提升时，有些战甲生来就是 Prime 的。Lavos 是炼制术大师，他从不向任何人低头，而是开辟了自己的英勇之路。

abilities.description:
Lash out with a toxic serpentine strike, consuming the target to heal Lavos.

Hold to imbue all abilities with <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin.
abilities.zhDescription:
施放一次毒蛇猛击，通过消耗目标的生命值来治疗 Lavos。

长按来为所有技能注入<DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害。

abilities.description:
Dash forward, crashing through enemies and leaving an icy trail of broken vials.

Hold to imbue the next ability cast with <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold.
abilities.zhDescription:
前冲直撞穿过敌军，并留下破碎药瓶的冰迹。

长按来为下一次的技能施放注入<DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害。

abilities.description:
Launch a probe that converts Health and Energy Orbs into Universal Orbs that provide both, and ammo pickups into Universal Ammo Pickups. The probe shocks enemies in close proximity. Each electrocuted foe reduces other ability cooldowns by 1.5s.

Hold to imbue the next ability cast with <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity.
abilities.zhDescription:
布下一枚探头，来把生命球和能量球转化为可提供这两种补给的通用补给球，也可把弹药拾取物转换为通用弹药拾取物。探头也会电击近距离的敌人。每击中一名敌人，其它技能的冷却时间减少 1.5 秒。

长按来为下一次的技能施放注入<DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害。

abilities.description:
Catalyst Probes erupt from Lavos and douse combatants in a fiery gel. Damage is doubled for each element afflicting an enemy.

Hold to imbue the next ability cast with <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat.
abilities.zhDescription:
从 Lavos 体内迸发出催化探头，并把炽热的凝胶泼向对手。敌人身上每有一种元素异常状态，该技能的伤害便翻倍一次。

长按来为下一次的技能施放注入 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Alchemist/Alchemist.name: Lavos
/Lotus/Powersuits/Alchemist/Alchemist.description: The serpents of Lavos encourage him as he transmutes the battlefield. He uses Toxin, Cold, Electricity, and Heat to deal elemental damage. Harness the power of the dark alchemist.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Alchemist/Alchemist.zhDescription: 当 Lavos 转化战场时， 他的蛇鼓励着他。他使用毒素、冰冻、电击和火焰来造成元素伤害。掌控黑暗炼金术士的力量。

/Lotus/Powersuits/EntratiMech/NechroTech.name: Voidrig
/Lotus/Powersuits/EntratiMech/NechroTech.description: Nothing fancy but gets the job done and then some. With its electrified armor, this rough and ready mech can make the battlefield treacherous for the enemy with an arsenal of explosives.
/Lotus/Powersuits/EntratiMech/NechroTech.zhDescription: （英文：VOIDRIG）虽然外表不怎么光鲜亮丽，但却能出色地完成工作。凭借其电能护甲，这款粗糙且整装待发的机甲能够携带大量爆炸物，让战场上的敌人陷入苦战。

abilities.description: Hurl a canister of graviton fluids to create a wide mire that will significantly slow enemies traveling across it. Alternatively, the canister can be shot in mid-air to create a fiery conflagration.
abilities.zhDescription: 抛出一罐引力液体来制造一片宽阔的泥沼，在泥沼上行进的敌人会大大减速。此外，也可以将罐子射向半空来制造烈焰。

abilities.description: Swathe the Necramech in a powerful electrical field that greatly enhances survivability in close combat. Enemies that strike the shroud will suffer for their impudence.
abilities.zhDescription: 将殁世机甲笼罩在一道强力电场中，以大幅提升近战时的生存能力。击中这一电场罩的敌人会为他们的无礼付出代价。

abilities.description: Launch a pattern of charged mines all around you. Each mine detonates in a violent blast when touched, damaging enemies in a three-meter radius.
abilities.zhDescription: 在周围布下一圈带电地雷。每个地雷在被碰触时都会产生剧烈爆炸，并对周围半径 3 米内的敌人产生伤害。

abilities.description: Take a stationary stance to deploy maximum firepower and gain increased structural integrity for a time.
abilities.zhDescription: 采取静止姿态来部署最大火力，并在一段时间内获得结构完整性的提升。

/Lotus/Powersuits/EntratiMech/ThanoTech.name: Bonewidow
/Lotus/Powersuits/EntratiMech/ThanoTech.description: This fearsome Necramech, fashioned in honor of the Entrati matriarch, is a robust front-line fighter. Favoring armor and health over shield strength, Bonewidow can grab and hurl enemies, deploy a heavy shield for personal defense, and cleave through opposing ranks with a massive warblade.
/Lotus/Powersuits/EntratiMech/ThanoTech.zhDescription: （英文：BONEWIDOW）这架慑人的殁世机甲，是为了纪念英择谛的女族长而设计的，这是一个强健的前线战士。相较于护盾强度，骨骸寡妇在护甲和生命值上更占优势。她可以抓起敌人并将其猛掷出去，或是部署一个重型盾牌来进行个人防御，又或是以巨大的战刃在敌军中杀出一条血路。

abilities.description: Skewer and hold a target, siphoning their health. Use again to hurl the victim damaging them and anyone near the impact site.
abilities.zhDescription: 刺穿并抓住一个目标来吸取他们的生命值。再次使用该技能来把受害者用力掷出，以对他们和撞击点附近的任何人造成伤害。

abilities.description: Raise Bonewidow's shield to block incoming forward damage, reflecting it back at attackers. While active, bash enemies with a Maiden's Kiss.
abilities.zhDescription: 举起骨骸寡妇的盾牌，以阻挡前方来袭的伤害，并将该伤害反弹给攻击者。在技能激活时，通过「室女之吻」来打击敌人。

abilities.description: Sweep surrounding enemies into the line of fire and suspend them in air with a force beam.
abilities.zhDescription: 通过一道强力光束将周围的敌人扫入火线并将他们悬空。

abilities.description: Summon a devastating exalted blade.
abilities.zhDescription: 召唤毁天灭地的显赫武器。

/Lotus/Powersuits/SiriusOrion/OrionSuit.name: Orion & Sirius
/Lotus/Powersuits/SiriusOrion/OrionSuit.description: Wield the power of the stars in a constant battle for supremacy. The dueling sons, Sirius & Orion, occupy the space of a single Warframe, jockeying for position to rain cosmic destruction upon foes.
/Lotus/Powersuits/SiriusOrion/OrionSuit.zhDescription: 在永无休止的霸权争夺战中，驾驭星辰之力。Sirius 与 Orion 这对决斗之子，在同一个战甲中，彼此角力，争相占据有利位置，向敌人倾泻宇宙级的毁灭之力。

abilities.description:
Repel enemies with Orion's sinister scythe, dealing <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage and Status Effect while reducing shields and armor.

(HOLD) Swap to Sirius and use Coronal Ejection.
abilities.zhDescription:
使用 Orion 的邪恶镰刀击退敌人，造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割伤害和异常状态，同时削弱敌人的护盾和护甲。

（按住）切换到 Sirius 并使用日冕抛射。

abilities.description:
Envelop Orion in an Astral Shell. Upon taking damage the shell becomes a decoy that draws fire until it's destroyed.

(HOLD) Swap to Sirius and use Jade Stars.
abilities.zhDescription:
将 Orion 包裹在星壳中。外壳受到伤害后会变成诱饵，吸引火力直至被摧毁。

（按住）切换到 Sirius 并使用翠玉之星。

abilities.description:
Orion forms a drifting black hole, trapping enemies within its gravity. Hitting the black hole with Gravitic Slash or Coronal Ejection will extend its duration and change its trajectory: Gravitic Slash will direct it away from Orion, and Coronal Ejection will pull it towards Sirius.

(HOLD) Swap to Sirius and use Light's Sanctuary.
abilities.zhDescription:
Orion 形成一个漂移的黑洞，将敌人困于其引力之中。以「重力斩」或「日冕抛射」命中黑洞可延长其持续时间，并改变其移动轨迹：「重力斩」会使其远离 Orion，而「日冕抛射」会将其拉向 Sirius。

（按住）切换至 Sirius 并使用「光之圣域」。

abilities.description:
Sirius & Orion take to the skies in a cosmic duel. Each attack consumes a Constellation Star to inflict colossal collateral |DAMAGE_TYPE| damage. Match the star's color to the Warframes color to gain increased Critical Chance.

|LEFT_ATTACK| Sirius attacks
|RIGHT_ATTACK| Orion attacks

Generate Constellation Stars by using abilities. No more than two stars of the same color can be added in a row.
abilities.zhDescription:
Sirius & Orion 在宇宙中展开决斗。每次攻击都会消耗一颗众星，造成巨大的附加 |DAMAGE_TYPE|伤害。将星星的颜色与战甲颜色匹配，可提高暴击几率。

|LEFT_ATTACK| Sirius 攻击
|RIGHT_ATTACK| Orion 攻击

使用技能以生成众星。同一颜色的星星最多只能连续生成两颗。
